items.title: Anthropic 數據揭示：AI 代理工時是人類六倍，初級職位佔比降至 14%
items.title_en: Anthropic Data: AI Agents Log 6× More Hours Than Humans, Junior Roles Drop to 14%
items.summary: Anthropic 公開員工結構數據：AI 代理工時達人類的六倍，初級技術職位佔比從 21% 降至 14%，新聘初級職位從 27% 跌至 9%，工程師人均程式碼提交量增加逾五倍。
items.summary_en: Anthropic disclosed that AI agents now log 6× more hours than its human employees, while junior technical roles fell from 21% to 14% of staff. Engineers are shipping 5× more code per person.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 代理正取代初級崗位，代理商需評估自身人力結構面臨的相應壓力。
items.why_en: AI agents are displacing junior roles — agencies should assess equivalent workforce pressure now.
highlights: AI 代理工時已達 Anthropic 人類員工的六倍，研究部門的比例更高達 19:1。
初級技術職位佔比從 21% 降至 14%，新聘初級職位從 27% 跌至 9%。
工程師人均程式碼提交量增加逾五倍，反映 AI 輔助下個人產出大幅提升。
highlights_en: AI agents log 6× more hours than human employees at Anthropic, reaching 19:1 in the research division.
Junior technical staff share fell from 21% to 14%; new junior hires dropped from 27% to 9%.
Engineers ship 5.1× more code commits per person, reflecting dramatically higher individual output with AI assistance.
items.detail:
Anthropic 近期公開了一份內部勞動力分析報告，揭示其組織架構正在發生結構性轉變。最顯著的指標，是初級技術職員佔技術部門的比例，已由 2025 年初的 21% 降至目前的 14%；若以新進初級職員佔整體招聘比例計算，跌幅更為陡峭——從 27% 急降至 9%。技術職員佔全體員工的比例亦同步收縮，由 61% 下降至 56%，主要原因是非技術職能部門擴張，以及業務人員已能直接使用 AI 工具自行完成原本需要工程師介入的任務。

報告揭示的另一組數據，同樣值得香港代理商管理層正視：AI 代理（Claude）的工時遠超人類員工。研究部門中，代理與人類的工時比例達到 19:1；工程師則平均產出多出五倍的程式碼提交量，且未見任何代碼質素下滑的跡象。與此同時，2026 年 4 月一份內部問卷顯示，27% 的員工表示因使用 Claude 而顯著提升生產力，20% 的員工描述自身角色已從「直接執行」轉變為「管理多個 Claude 實例」。這一轉變重新定義了何謂「高價值員工」——能夠設計任務框架、審核 AI 輸出及承擔問責的人，正在取代純粹執行的角色。

值得注意的是，效率提升並未帶來會議時間的減少，反而相反。報告顯示，每位員工的會議時間按年上升 20%，技術人員的會議時間更增加 16%。Anthropic 的解釋是，AI 大量生成內容之後，人類的核心職責轉向信任建立與責任確認，面對面協調反而變得更加關鍵，而非更少。一名工程師甚至以「保姆」比喻自身現況——同時照看多個正在並行運作的 AI 代理，每一個都需要相當程度的注意力。

對於正在評估 AI 轉型路徑的香港行銷代理商而言，這份報告提供了一個具參考價值的早期樣本。首先，招聘策略需要重新校準：初級執行職位不會完全消失，然而其佔比壓縮幾乎是必然趨勢，未來的初級員工需要從入職第一天起就具備「管理 AI 輸出」的能力，而非單純執行重複性任務。其次，管理層需要在組織設計上預留更多橫向協調資源——隨著 AI 工具的滲透率提升，跨部門談定同一個決策、分清誰負責的成本，往往比預期中更高。
items.detail_en:
Anthropic's recently published internal workforce analysis reveals a structural shift in how the company is organized. The most striking headline figure: junior technical staff have fallen from 21% of the technical workforce in early 2025 to just 14% today. New junior technical hires show an even sharper decline — dropping from 27% of all new hires to just 9%. Technical staff as a share of total headcount also contracted, from 61% to 56%, driven by growth in non-technical business functions and by non-engineers increasingly using AI tools to complete tasks that once required developer support.

The productivity data accompanying these figures deserves close attention from agency leaders in Hong Kong. AI agents — specifically Claude — now log working hours at a ratio of 19:1 versus human researchers in Anthropic's research division. Engineers are producing five times more code commits without any measurable decline in quality. An April 2026 internal survey found 27% of employees reported significant productivity gains attributable to Claude, while 20% described their role as having shifted from direct execution to 'managing multiple Claude instances.' This redefines what a high-value employee looks like: the premium is increasingly on people who can frame tasks, audit AI output, and bear accountability — not those who simply execute.

Counter-intuitively, these efficiency gains have not reduced meeting time. Per-employee meeting time rose 20% year-over-year overall, and 16% among technical contributors specifically. Anthropic attributes this to a shift in the nature of human work: once AI handles the production volume, human attention becomes the bottleneck for trust-building and accountability verification, making in-person coordination more critical rather than less. One engineer described the experience as 'babysitting' — simultaneously managing multiple Claude instances, each demanding meaningful attention.

For Hong Kong marketing agencies evaluating their own AI transition roadmap, this report offers a rare early-stage data point from an organization that is arguably the world's most AI-saturated workforce. Three practical implications stand out. First, hiring strategy needs recalibration: junior execution roles will not vanish entirely, but compression is near-certain, and any new junior hire must be prepared from day one to manage AI output rather than replace it. Second, management structures must budget for more lateral coordination overhead — as AI penetration increases, cross-functional decision alignment and accountability definition consistently cost more than anticipated. Third, Anthropic explicitly positions itself as an early indicator for economy-wide labor shifts; agencies that begin tracking analogous internal metrics now will be far better positioned to plan workforce strategy 12 to 24 months ahead.

items.title: Replit 將預設模型由 Claude 切換至 OpenAI，前五大客戶出走
items.title_en: Replit Replaces Claude with OpenAI as Default Model, a Top-Five Anthropic Customer Exits
items.summary: Replit CEO 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 宣布，以成本、效能及合作深度為由，將 Replit Agent 預設模型由 Claude 換為 OpenAI，Replit 曾是 Anthropic 的前五大客戶之一。
items.summary_en: Replit CEO announced at TechCrunch Disrupt that OpenAI now powers Replit Agent by default, replacing Claude. Replit was previously a top-five Anthropic customer; Claude remains as a manual option.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 頂級 AI 工具平台的模型忠誠度出現流動，代理商工具鏈的供應商鎖定風險需重新評估。
items.why_en: Model loyalty at leading AI platforms is fluid — agencies should reassess toolchain lock-in risk.
highlights: Replit 曾是 Anthropic 的前五大客戶之一，此次切換具有指標性意義。
Claude 仍作為手動選項保留，現有使用者的工作流程不受影響，默認體驗已改變。
此舉進一步加劇 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 在開發者平台市場的供應商競爭。
highlights_en: Replit was previously a top-five Anthropic customer, making this switch a significant signal for the AI platform market.
Claude remains available as a manual option; existing workflows are unaffected, but the default experience has changed.
The move intensifies competition between Anthropic and OpenAI for developer platform partnerships.
items.detail:
在 2026 年 10 月的 TechCrunch Disrupt 大會上，Replit 執行長 Amjad Masad 公開宣布，平台已將預設 AI 模型由 Anthropic 的 Claude 切換至 OpenAI，並正式確認 OpenAI 為 Replit Agent 的「首選合作夥伴」。Replit 曾是 Anthropic 排名前五位的付費客戶，合作期間幫助其收入實現約十倍增長。這次轉換標誌著 AI 基礎模型市場迄今最具份量的客戶流失事件之一。

Masad 給出三個理由：效能方面，內部基準測試顯示 OpenAI 模型在從零構建「vibe-coded」應用程式上表現更佳；成本方面，OpenAI 提供更具競爭力的定價；合作深度方面，他形容 OpenAI「目前是更好的夥伴」。值得注意的是，OpenAI 合作關係早於 2026 年 8 月已宣布，而 Anthropic 出局的消息卻拖延近兩個月才曝光——直至 9 月下旬，Replit 文件仍在推廣 Claude Fable 5 及 Opus 5.5，商業決策與公開溝通之間的落差令外界側目。

這次事件的核心啟示，在於 AI 模型供應商的黏性遠低於傳統軟件。「預設」位置才是真正的戰略資產：絕大多數用戶從不主動切換模型，失去預設等同失去絕大部分流量。對於在業務中構建或採購 AI 工具的香港代理商，有兩個實務要點：其一，評估任何 AI 平台時，應主動詢問底層模型及供應商的切換政策——按某模型能力設計的工作流程，可能因靜默替換而退化；其二，過度依賴單一模型供應商帶來架構脆弱性，保持模型層可替換性是降低長期風險的基本設計原則。Replit 企業收入佔比已由 2025 年約 2% 升至 2026 年約 15%，預計 2027 年超過 50%，亦印證企業客戶對 AI 工具供應商穩定性的關注度正在持續上升。
items.detail_en:
At TechCrunch Disrupt in October 2026, Replit CEO Amjad Masad publicly announced that the platform had switched its default AI model from Anthropic's Claude to OpenAI, naming OpenAI the 'preferred partner' powering Replit Agent. Replit had been among Anthropic's top-five paying customers — a relationship that helped Replit grow its revenue roughly tenfold. This switch marks one of the most significant customer departures in the AI foundation model market to date.

Masad cited three reasons: performance (internal benchmarks showed OpenAI models outperform Claude when building vibe-coded applications from scratch), cost (more competitive pricing), and partnership quality (OpenAI described as 'a better partner for now'). Notably, the OpenAI collaboration was announced back in August 2026, yet Anthropic's displacement did not emerge until nearly two months later — as recently as late September 2026, Replit's documentation was still actively promoting Claude Fable 5 and Opus 5.5, exposing a significant gap between commercial decisions and public communications.

The core lesson of this episode is that AI model vendor stickiness is far lower than traditional software lock-in. The 'default' slot is the true strategic asset: the vast majority of users never manually switch models, so losing default status means losing the bulk of platform traffic. For Hong Kong agencies building or procuring AI-powered tools, two practical points stand out. First, when evaluating any AI platform, actively ask what the underlying model is and what the vendor's policy is on switching — a workflow designed around a specific model's capabilities may degrade silently after a substitution. Second, over-reliance on a single model vendor creates architectural fragility; maintaining substitutability at the model layer is a basic risk-management principle. Replit's enterprise revenue growing from approximately 2% in 2025 to 15% in 2026 — with projections exceeding 50% by 2027 — also confirms that enterprise clients are placing increasing weight on AI tooling vendor stability.

items.title: Stripe：AI 代理交易量按月激增 38 倍，零售與旅遊率先突破
items.title_en: Stripe: AI Agent Transaction Count Up 38× Month-on-Month, Retail and Travel Lead
items.summary: Stripe 數據顯示 9 月 AI 代理交易筆數按月增長 38 倍、金額增 20 倍。現有約 200 個活躍代理，每筆平均約 100 美元，零售佔 36% 交易量，旅遊佔 28% 金額。
items.summary_en: Stripe reports AI agent transaction count grew 38× and volume grew 20× month-over-month in September. Approximately 200 agents are active, averaging ~$100 per transaction. Retail leads with 36% of transactions; travel accounts for 28% of value.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 代理的自主消費規模正快速成形，零售與旅遊客戶的歸因模型需要重新設計。
items.why_en: AI agent purchasing is scaling fast — agencies with retail or travel clients must rethink attribution models now.
items.pattern: AI 代理自主消費正在建立全新購買渠道。未來十二個月，預計出現品牌 AI 代理（如 Meta Muse）與零售商庫存系統的直接採購協議，廣告的角色將從「影響決策」演變為「影響代理行為設定」。
items.pattern_en: Autonomous AI agent purchasing is forming a new buying channel. Over the next twelve months, expect direct procurement links between brand AI agents (like Meta Muse) and retailer inventory systems — advertising's role will shift from influencing human decisions to influencing the behavior settings of agents.
highlights: Stripe 目前活躍 AI 代理約 200 個，包括 Meta Muse 與 Grok Bot，每筆平均交易金額約 100 美元。
零售佔 AI 代理交易筆數的 36%，旅遊佔金額的 28%，是滲透速度最快的兩個消費類別。
AI 代理購物將改變現有歸因模型，廣告效果如何在代理決策鏈中被追蹤仍是未解的業界難題。
highlights_en: Approximately 200 AI agents are active on Stripe, including Meta Muse and Grok Bot, with an average transaction of ~$100.
Retail accounts for 36% of transactions; travel accounts for 28% of total volume — the two fastest-growing categories.
AI agent purchasing disrupts existing attribution models; how ad effectiveness is tracked through agent decision chains remains an open industry question.
items.detail:
Stripe 近期披露，其平台上的 AI 代理交易量在 9 月份按月激增 38 倍，支付金額則上升 20 倍。儘管 Stripe 拒絕公開具體的絕對數值，這組倍數增長的數據仍具有重要的信號意義——它代表代理式消費正從理論走入可量化的商業現實。目前已有約 200 個 AI 代理在 Stripe 上活躍交易，其中包括 Meta 的 Muse 及 Grok Bot 等知名實例，而 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 雖已接入 Stripe 的 Link 平台，但暫時尚未用於代理購買場景。

從行業分布來看，零售佔全部代理交易筆數的 36%，旅遊佔支付金額的 28%。代理交易的典型客單價約為 100 美元，惟個別高價場景——例如機票預訂與高端家具購買——可達數千美元。Stripe 的技術架構採用代理虛擬卡號（proxy 16 位卡號）取代用戶真實信用卡資訊，並允許用戶設定消費上限，以此兼顧自動化效率與安全控制。Stripe 高管 Dan Hill 坦承，這個市場仍處於「非常早期的階段」，PayPal 及 Shopify 的 Shop Pay 均已在同一方向佈局。

這組數據對香港從事零售及旅遊客戶業務的行銷代理商，有深遠的結構性影響。傳統的轉化歸因邏輯，預設消費決策的主體是人類——人類點擊廣告、人類瀏覽商品頁、人類完成結帳。一旦 AI 代理作為交易主體介入，這條歸因鏈條的根本假設便告崩塌。代理的購買行為未必源自廣告曝光，更可能源自其訓練數據中的品牌印象、用戶歷史偏好或即時比價邏輯。換言之，品牌在「代理決策層」的存在感，將逐步成為一個獨立的行銷競爭維度。

對於代理商的實際業務規劃，以下三個面向需要提前思考。第一，轉化漏斗的衡量方式必須演進：點擊率、頁面瀏覽量等以人類行為為前提的指標，對代理交易而言意義有限，代理商應與客戶共同探討如何追蹤及歸因代理發起的購買行為。第二，零售與旅遊客戶的商品資料結構化程度將直接影響其被 AI 代理選取的機率——結構清晰、資訊完整的產品資料更容易被代理解析與比較，這實際上是一個新形態的「搜尋引擎優化」課題。
items.detail_en:
Stripe has disclosed that AI agent transaction counts on its platform surged 38-fold month-over-month in September, with payment volume climbing 20-fold over the same period. While Stripe declined to release absolute figures, these multipliers carry significant signal value — they represent agentic commerce crossing from theoretical possibility into quantifiable commercial reality. Approximately 200 AI agents are now active on Stripe, including notable examples such as Meta's Muse and Grok Bot. Anthropic and OpenAI have integrated with Stripe's Link platform, though not yet for agent purchasing use cases.

By industry, retail accounts for 36% of agent transaction counts and travel represents 28% of payment volume. The typical agent transaction runs around $100, though high-value scenarios — such as flight bookings and premium furniture purchases — can reach several thousand dollars. Stripe's technical architecture issues a proxy 16-digit card number rather than exposing users' actual payment credentials, with user-configurable spending limits designed to balance automation efficiency with financial control. Stripe executive Dan Hill acknowledged the space remains 'in its very early days,' with PayPal and Shopify's Shop Pay already moving in the same direction.

For Hong Kong agencies serving retail and travel clients, this data points toward a structural disruption that will reshape the foundations of conversion attribution. Traditional attribution logic assumes a human decision-maker: a human clicks an ad, browses a product page, and completes checkout. Once an AI agent becomes the transacting party, the fundamental premise of that attribution chain breaks down. Agent purchasing behavior may not originate from ad exposure at all — it may stem from the agent's training data, the user's historical preferences, or real-time price comparison logic. A brand's prominence in 'agent decision space' is beginning to emerge as a distinct competitive dimension in marketing.

Three areas require forward planning for agencies. First, conversion funnel measurement must evolve: click-through rates and page view metrics premised on human behavior offer limited insight into agent-initiated transactions, and agencies should work with clients to define how agentic purchases will be tracked and attributed. Second, the structured quality of a retail or travel client's product data will directly influence how readily AI agents select their offerings — clean, complete, machine-readable product information is emerging as a new form of search optimization. Third, absolute transaction volumes remain small and the month-over-month multipliers largely reflect a low base effect; agencies should place this on a 12-to-18-month strategic watch list rather than treating it as requiring immediate comprehensive response.

items.title: 德國兩家法院裁定 Google 須為 AI 概覽內容負出版商責任
items.title_en: Two German Courts Rule Google Is Liable as Publisher for AI Overview Content
items.summary: 德國慕尼黑與亞琛法院先後裁定 Google AI 概覽屬於 Google 自身陳述而非中立引用，須負出版商責任，違反亞琛法院禁制令每次最高罰款 25 萬歐元。
items.summary_en: Courts in Munich and Aachen ruled Google AI Overviews constitute Google's own statements, not neutral references, making Google directly liable as a publisher. Violations carry fines up to €250,000.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 搜尋摘要的法律責任模式正在歐洲成形，品牌資訊遭誤述的監測與更正機制已成必要配置。
items.why_en: Europe is building a publisher-liability model for AI search — brand monitoring and correction protocols are now essential.
items.pattern: 歐洲法院正在確立 AI 搜尋摘要的出版商責任模式。若此判決在歐盟層面獲得確認，Google 可能被迫縮減 AI 概覽中對特定品牌與產品的具體陳述，推動 GEO（生成式引擎優化）從加分項變成必備項。
items.pattern_en: European courts are establishing publisher liability for AI search summaries. If confirmed at EU level, Google may limit specific brand and product claims in AI Overviews — accelerating GEO from a nice-to-have to a baseline requirement.
highlights: 兩德國法院認定 Google AI 概覽不屬中立引用，Google 因此須如傳統出版商般對搜尋摘要內容直接負責。
亞琛法院禁制令規定，每次違反最高可被罰款 25 萬歐元，AI 搜尋的法律問責門檻已正式確立。
此判決或推動歐洲其他司法管轄區跟進，進而影響 Google 全球 AI 搜尋產品的設計邏輯。
highlights_en: Both German courts found Google AI Overviews represent Google's own assertions, establishing direct publisher liability for AI-generated search summaries.
The Aachen injunction sets a €250,000 fine per violation, formally establishing an accountability threshold for AI search.
The ruling may prompt similar actions across Europe, influencing how Google designs its AI search products globally.
items.detail:
2026 年，德國兩家地方法院相繼就 Google AI 概覽（AI Overviews）的法律責任作出裁定，確立了一個迄今在全球範圍內尚屬首例的法律原則：AI 生成的搜尋摘要構成平台自身的「獨立聲明」，而非對第三方資訊的中立引用，Google 因此須以出版商身份承擔相應法律責任。

兩宗案件的事實背景截然不同，結論卻高度一致。慕尼黑第一地區法院於 2026 年 5 月裁定，Google 的 AI 錯誤地將兩名慕尼黑出版商與欺詐案件掛鈎，相關 AI 概覽構成 Google 的自身言論，而非搜尋結果連結。Google 隨後提出上訴，最終以庭外和解告終，惟法律推理並未因此被推翻。亞琛地區法院的案件則更為戲劇性：一名神經放射學教授發現，Google 的 AI Mode 將一宗涉及另一名教授的性侵指控，完整地「歸因」到他名下，包含捏造的多段陳述與虛構的法律程序細節。Google 在收到通知後逾兩周拒絕採取行動，亞琛法院隨即在未給予 Google 陳詞機會的情況下發出緊急禁制令，每項違規的潛在罰款上限為 25 萬歐元。

亞琛法院在判決書中明確援引慕尼黑案的推理，指出 Google 的 AI 產出的是「獨立、嶄新且實質性的陳述」，而非對外部來源的摘要引用。法院亦指出，Google 具備技術能力核實其 AI 輸出與原始網站的一致性，卻選擇不採取行動，這進一步強化了其主動承擔發布責任的邏輯依據。

這一系列裁決對香港行銷代理商的品牌監測業務具有直接的實務意涵。歐洲的法律判決雖不直接約束香港，然而跨國企業客戶——尤其是在歐洲有業務的品牌——將需要在其全球品牌保護策略中納入 AI 搜尋監測的維度。更根本的問題是：AI 概覽正在成為搜尋結果頁最顯眼的位置，一旦其中出現關於品牌的不準確陳述，其傳播速度與曝光規模遠超傳統負面新聞。代理商應主動建議客戶將 Google AI 概覽、Microsoft Copilot 搜尋摘要等 AI 生成回覆，納入現有的品牌監測框架，定期測試品牌關鍵詞在各大 AI 搜尋工具中的生成結果，並建立相應的糾錯通報流程。
items.detail_en:
In 2026, two German regional courts issued rulings on Google AI Overviews that establish a legal principle with no clear precedent elsewhere in the world: AI-generated search summaries constitute the platform's own original statements rather than neutral references to third-party information, making Google liable as a publisher.

The two cases arose from very different facts but reached strikingly consistent conclusions. Munich Regional Court I ruled in May 2026 that Google's AI had falsely linked two Munich publishers to fraud schemes, classifying the AI Overviews as Google's own statements rather than search result links. Google appealed and ultimately settled out of court, but the underlying legal reasoning was never overturned. The Aachen case was more dramatic: a neuroradiology professor discovered that Google's AI Mode had attributed a sexual assault allegation involving a different professor to him, complete with fabricated multi-paragraph accounts and invented legal proceedings. After Google failed to act for more than two weeks following notification, the Aachen court issued an emergency injunction without hearing Google's response, with potential fines of up to €250,000 per violation.

The Aachen court explicitly cited Munich's reasoning, finding that Google's AI produces 'independent, new, and substantive statements' rather than summaries of external sources. The court further noted that Google possesses the technical capability to verify its AI outputs against source websites and chose not to do so — a finding that reinforces the rationale for treating Google as an active publisher rather than a passive intermediary.

For Hong Kong marketing agencies, these rulings carry direct practical implications for brand monitoring services. European court decisions do not bind Hong Kong directly, but multinational clients — particularly brands with European operations — will need to incorporate AI search monitoring into their global brand protection strategy. The more fundamental issue is that AI Overviews now occupy the most prominent position on many search result pages; inaccurate statements about a brand appearing there can spread at a speed and scale that far exceeds traditional negative press. Agencies should proactively advise clients to include Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot search summaries, and equivalent AI-generated responses within their existing brand monitoring frameworks — regularly testing brand keywords across major AI search tools and establishing correction and escalation procedures. The 'publisher liability' theory established by the German courts also signals that brand owners will have increasingly clear legal recourse when AI search summaries produce false statements about their organizations.

items.title: Anthropic 與律師事務所合作，為 AI 代理商業議價制定行為規範
items.title_en: Anthropic Works with Law Firms to Set Behavioral Standards for AI Agent Commercial Negotiations

items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.why_en: AI agents autonomously negotiating for clients are imminent — agencies must rethink procurement, media buying, and contract workflows.

Anthropic 正以每月逾十萬美元薪酬聘用法律領域「概念推理研究員」，反映 AI 代理行為規範研究已進入實質階段。
AI 代理談判行為準則一旦確立，廣告採購、媒體議價等代理商核心業務的運作方式將直接受到影響。
highlights_en: Tests show more capable AI models secure better deal terms, raising concerns about commercial inequality between users with different AI tiers.
Anthropic is hiring legal 'Conceptual Reasoning Fellows' at $100K–$167K per month, showing AI agent behavior research has entered a concrete phase.
Once AI agent negotiation norms are established, core agency functions like media buying and ad procurement will be directly affected.
items.detail:
Anthropic 正與多家律師事務所合作，為 AI 代理在商業議價場景中的行為制定規範框架。其內部研究揭示一個極具商業意涵的發現：更強大的 AI 模型在議價場景中能夠獲取更優惠的條件。這意味著能負擔高端 AI 工具的企業，在採購、合約及媒介購買談判中將系統性佔優，而只能使用較弱版本代理的中小型企業，則面臨結構性的談判劣勢。Anthropic 選擇在大規模部署之前主動建立規範，本身已釋出明確信號：AI 代理替代人類進行商業議價，是可預見的近期現實，而非遠期議題。

為解決「人文判斷力稀缺」的問題，Anthropic 推出了「概念推理研究員」（Conceptual Reasoning Fellows）計劃，以每月 10 萬至 16.7 萬美元的薪酬，聘用具備法律、哲學、認知科學、經濟學及政治學背景的專業人士參與四個月項目，協助構建測試案例與評估標準。研究人員坦言，在法律領域「定義質量本身就是出了名的困難」，這正是人文判斷力的不可替代性所在。

對於香港行銷代理商，AI 代理介入媒介購買與合約談判需要提前佈局。首先，代理商的核心職能之一——媒介議價——若由 AI 代理執行，效果取決於底層模型的能力層級；需明確評估所用 AI 工具是否具備足夠的推理能力。其次，當客戶端與媒體供應商端的 AI 代理直接對接交易，傳統以人際關係為基礎的媒體採購生態將面臨根本重構，代理商必須重新思考自身在此架構中的定位與附加價值。第三，Anthropic 與律師事務所合作制定行為規範，預示相關行業標準正在成形；提前了解這些規範走向的代理商，將更有能力為客戶提供合規諮詢，並在新的 AI 議價生態中確立專業地位。
items.detail_en:
Anthropic is working with law firms to develop behavioral standards for AI agents operating in commercial negotiation contexts. Internal research has surfaced a finding with significant commercial and societal implications: more capable AI models secure better outcomes in negotiation scenarios. This means companies that can afford premium AI tools will systematically obtain more favorable results in procurement, contract, and media buying negotiations, while smaller businesses limited to lower-capability agents face a structural negotiating disadvantage. Anthropic's decision to build norms proactively, before widespread deployment, itself signals a clear judgment: AI agents conducting commercial negotiations on behalf of humans is an imminent near-term reality.

To address the scarcity of humanistic judgment expertise, Anthropic launched a 'Conceptual Reasoning Fellows' program, offering $100,000 to $167,000 per month to professionals with backgrounds in law, philosophy, cognitive science, economics, and political science for four-month engagements. These fellows help build test cases and evaluation criteria that strengthen Claude in judgment-intensive domains. Researchers acknowledge that in law, 'defining quality is notoriously hard' — precisely why human judgment remains irreplaceable in this work.

For Hong Kong marketing agencies, AI agents intervening in media buying and contract negotiations require forward preparation on three fronts. First, media rate negotiation — one of the agency's core functions — will, if executed by AI agents, depend heavily on the capability tier of the underlying model; agencies must critically assess whether their AI tooling has sufficient reasoning capacity for this purpose. Second, when client-side and media supplier-side AI agents transact directly, the relationship-based media buying ecosystem faces fundamental restructuring, and agencies must rethink their positioning and added value within that architecture. Third, Anthropic's collaboration with law firms signals that industry standards are beginning to take shape; agencies that develop early familiarity with these standards will be better positioned to offer compliance guidance and establish professional standing in the emerging AI-negotiated media ecosystem.

items.title: Meta 修訂服務條款後仍保留商業網站數據收集權，10 月 30 日前須確認
items.title_en: Meta Revised Terms Still Allow Business Website Data Collection — Review Before Oct 30
items.summary: Meta 撤回廣泛抓取條文後，修訂版條款仍保留以商業網站數據支持廣告投放的授權。企業僅能以 robots.txt 表達偏好，完全退出須刪除 Meta 帳號。
items.summary_en: Meta pulled broad scraping language after legal pushback, but revised terms still authorize using business website data for ad targeting. Companies can signal preferences via robots.txt but cannot fully opt out without deleting their Meta account.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 代理商管理的客戶 Facebook 商業帳號須於 10 月 30 日前審閱條款，並向客戶說明數據使用影響。
items.why_en: Agencies managing client Facebook Business accounts must review the revised terms before Oct 30 and brief clients on data implications.
highlights: Meta 最初新增允許抓取所有連結商業帳號網域的條文，遭法律專家批評形與廣泛授權後迅速撤回。
修訂後條款仍保留以商業網站數據支持廣告系統的授權，企業僅能透過 robots.txt 表達偏好，無法完全退出。
完全退出的唯一途徑是刪除 Meta 帳號，代理商需向客戶清晰說明這項限制及其對品牌數據的實際影響。
highlights_en: Meta initially added language granting broad crawling rights over business website domains, pulled after legal experts flagged it as overreach.
Revised terms still authorize using business website data for ad systems; companies can signal preferences via robots.txt but cannot fully opt out.
Complete opt-out requires deleting the Meta account — agencies must clearly explain this constraint and its data implications to clients.
items.detail:
Meta於2026年10月初發布修訂版服務條款，原版本引發法律界廣泛關注：條款草稿明確授權Meta使用「自動化軟體（包括網頁爬蟲、機器人、蜘蛛程式、爬行程式）」抓取企業帳戶所連結的所有網域與URL，並可定期提取更新內容用於訓練與研究。Nieman Lab引述的法律專家指出，原版措辭幾乎等同授予Meta無邊界的商業數據採集權，企業若不願接受，唯一退出途徑是在10月30日前關閉Meta帳戶。

面對輿論壓力，Meta發言人Daniel Roberts隨即澄清，相關爬取條款「僅適用於廣告及商業產品」，並已在修訂版中作出明確限縮。然而，仔細審視修訂後的條款，Meta保留透過爬取企業網站數據來優化廣告定向的權利，實質影響並未消失。換言之，凡繼續使用Meta廣告系統的企業，其官網內容仍可被Meta系統性地收集，用於改善廣告投放精準度。這一安排在當前AI廣告優化浪潮下，具有深遠的數據策略意涵。

就退出機制而言，Meta確認企業可透過robots.txt向平台「表達偏好」。值得注意的是，robots.txt在法律層面屬自願遵守協議，並無強制約束力，Meta措辭亦僅使用「signal their preferences」而非作出合規承諾。這意味著robots.txt無法提供硬性法律保障，僅代表企業的意願聲明。若要完全退出，唯有刪除帳戶，而此舉等同放棄Meta廣告生態系統的全部觸達能力。

對香港代理商而言，最緊迫的行動是在10月30日前向持有Meta Business帳戶的客戶作出知會。需要釐清的核心問題包括：客戶官網是否已設置robots.txt、現有robots.txt的覆蓋範圍是否足夠、以及客戶是否對Meta使用其網站數據進行AI模型訓練或廣告優化存有異議。部分涉及個人資料或受行業監管的客戶（例如金融、醫療）尤需謹慎評估，因其網站數據可能包含敏感分類資訊。代理商亦應更新與客戶的服務合約，明確數據收集情況的披露義務，以降低日後的法律風險。

Meta過去已因爬取行為面臨多宗訴訟，此次條款修訂雖作出表面收窄，實際上卻以更清晰的文字固化了其廣告數據收集的法律基礎。代理商應視此為長期數據主權議題的縮影——企業在Meta平台投放廣告所換取的，不只是觸達用戶的能力，也包括其自身數字資產被系統性收集與利用的默許授權。
items.detail_en:
In early October 2026, Meta released updated terms of service that immediately drew scrutiny from the legal community. The original draft explicitly authorized Meta to use 'automated software (such as web scrapers, bots, robots, spiders, crawlers)' to access all domains and URLs linked to business accounts, with the ability to periodically pull updates for training and research purposes. Legal experts cited by Nieman Lab noted the original language amounted to a near-unlimited grant of commercial data collection rights, with account deletion before October 30 as the only available opt-out.

Under public pressure, Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts clarified that the crawling provisions 'only applied to our ads and business products,' with revised language reflecting that narrowing. However, a careful reading of the updated terms confirms Meta still retains the right to collect business website data for ad-targeting optimization. In practical terms, any business continuing to use Meta's advertising system implicitly consents to having its website content systematically harvested to improve ad delivery — a significant data-strategy implication in the current era of AI-driven ad optimization.

On the opt-out mechanism, Meta confirmed that businesses may use robots.txt to 'signal their preferences.' Critically, robots.txt is a voluntary protocol with no binding legal force, and Meta's own wording stops short of any compliance guarantee. This means robots.txt provides no hard legal protection — it is a statement of preference, not a contractual right. Full opt-out remains only possible by deleting the account entirely, which effectively means abandoning access to Meta's entire advertising ecosystem.

For Hong Kong agencies, the most urgent action is briefing clients with Meta Business accounts before the October 30 deadline. Key questions to resolve include: whether the client's website has robots.txt configured, whether its current coverage is sufficient, and whether the client objects to Meta using their site data for AI model training or ad optimization. Clients in regulated industries — financial services, healthcare — face particular exposure, as their website data may contain sensitive or classified information. Agencies should also review client service agreements to ensure adequate disclosure of data collection practices, reducing future legal liability.

Meta has faced multiple lawsuits over scraping practices in recent years. While this revision appears to narrow the original terms, it simultaneously codifies the legal basis for ad-related data collection in clearer language than before. Agencies should treat this as a chapter in the broader data sovereignty story: businesses advertising on Meta are not merely buying reach — they are granting a standing, renewable license for their digital assets to be systematically collected and used.

items.title: Instagram 主管：AI 仿製原創內容趨勢令人憂慮，將擴大標籤要求
items.title_en: Instagram Chief: AI Content Mimicking Creators Is a Concern, Labeling Requirements Will Expand
items.summary: Instagram 主管 Adam Mosseri 對 AI 仿製創作者原創內容的趨勢感到憂慮，平台不會全面禁止 AI 內容，惟計劃擴大強制標籤範圍，AI 廣告素材亦在影響範圍內。
items.summary_en: Instagram head Adam Mosseri flagged growing AI content mimicking original creators and plans to expand AI labeling requirements. AI content will not be banned, but mandatory disclosure will widen.

items.detail:
Instagram主管Adam Mosseri近期公開表達對「AI Slop」現象的深切憂慮，導火線是一位藝術家在平台上公開投訴，指有人使用AI技術大量複製其個人藝術風格並廣泛傳播，而Instagram現有機制未能提供有效保護。Mosseri承認這是「棘手的問題」，並明確表示：「我對這種趨勢感到非常憂慮。」此番表態標誌著Meta在AI內容政策上的重要轉折——從過去積極鼓勵AI生成內容，轉向正視其對原創創作者生態造成的系統性衝擊。

Mosseri指出，現有版權申訴工具在面對AI仿製問題時存在根本性缺陷。許多原創創作者——包括喜劇演員、舞蹈表演者及各類風格藝術家——從未正式登記版權，其獨特的創作風格、敘事方式或表現手法在法律層面缺乏保護基礎。這使得AI仿製行為難以透過傳統的版權申訴路徑處理，而目前平台並無計劃全面禁止AI生成內容，而是選擇在透明度層面加大力度：擴大強制AI標籤的適用範圍，並以獎勵機制鼓勵創作者主動披露AI使用情況。

值得注意的是，此政策張力折射出Meta自身的戰略矛盾。Meta已承諾投入約6,000億美元用於AI基礎設施建設，並在平台內主動引導用戶生成AI圖像與影片，但這種由平台推動的AI內容供給，恰恰是「AI Slop」氾濫的結構性原因之一。若AI垃圾內容持續稀釋原創創作者的作品價值，創作者最終可能選擇離開Meta平台，而創作者生態的流失將深遠影響平台的廣告商業價值。

對於使用AI工具製作廣告素材的香港代理商，這一動向帶來直接的操作層面影響。首先，強制標籤範圍擴大後，AI生成的廣告創意有更大機率在Meta平台上被自動標記，且標記內容對用戶可見，可能影響廣告的感知可信度及品牌觀感。其次，若AI廣告素材在視覺風格或敘事框架上與知名創作者的作品高度相似，未來可能面臨更嚴格的平台審查，甚至觸發下架風險。代理商應在內部創意工作流程中建立AI使用紀錄，並評估各素材的標籤披露策略，而非被動等待平台政策落地後才作出應對。

從更宏觀的行業視角審視，此議題揭示了AI內容在商業環境中的信任邊界正在收窄。廣告主和消費者對AI生成內容的容忍度因類別而異——功能性資訊類廣告與強調品牌情感共鳴的創意之間，AI標籤所帶來的影響將大相逕庭。代理商應主動與客戶就AI素材的使用邊界達成共識，形成有據可查的決策框架，以備應對未來更嚴格的平台規管與客戶查詢。
items.detail_en:
Instagram head Adam Mosseri recently made a public statement expressing serious concern about the 'AI slop' phenomenon. The immediate trigger was an artist who publicly complained that AI tools were being used to massively replicate their personal artistic style across the platform, with existing mechanisms failing to provide any meaningful protection. Mosseri acknowledged it as 'a tricky problem' and stated directly: 'I am very worried about this trend.' The statement marks a significant inflection in Meta's AI content policy — shifting from active encouragement of AI-generated content toward acknowledging its systemic damage to the original creator ecosystem.

Mosseri identified a fundamental limitation in existing copyright claim tools when applied to AI mimicry. Many original creators — comedians, dancers, and stylistic artists of all kinds — have never formally registered copyright over their distinctive style, narrative voice, or performance approach, leaving them with no legal basis for protection. This makes AI mimicry difficult to address through traditional copyright channels. Rather than pursuing a blanket ban on AI content, the platform's stated response is to expand mandatory AI labeling and create incentive structures to encourage voluntary creator disclosure.

Notably, this policy tension reflects a genuine strategic contradiction within Meta itself. The company has committed approximately $600 billion to AI infrastructure investment and actively prompts users to generate AI images and videos within its platforms — making Meta itself a structural contributor to the slop problem it now publicly laments. If AI-generated content continues to dilute the value of original creator work, creators may ultimately migrate away from Meta's platforms, and the erosion of the creator ecosystem would meaningfully undermine Meta's advertising commercial value.

For Hong Kong agencies using AI tools to produce ad creatives, this development carries direct operational implications. As mandatory labeling expands, AI-generated ad assets face an increasing likelihood of being automatically flagged on Meta platforms, with labels visible to users — potentially affecting perceived credibility and brand perception. Additionally, AI ad creatives that closely mirror the visual style or narrative framing of known creators may face heightened platform scrutiny or takedown risk under evolving policies. Agencies should establish internal AI usage records within their creative workflow and develop a labeling disclosure strategy for each asset type, rather than waiting passively for policy enforcement to force a reactive response.

From a broader industry perspective, this episode signals that the trust perimeter for AI content in commercial contexts is narrowing. Advertiser and consumer tolerance for AI-generated content varies substantially by category — the impact of an AI label on a functional information ad versus one relying on brand emotional resonance will differ dramatically. Agencies should proactively align with clients on acceptable boundaries for AI creative use, building a documented decision framework that can withstand both stricter platform regulation and client scrutiny.

items.title: Meta 公開 Muse AI 三大商業場景：廣告查詢、排程設定、串接 Shopify 自動化

items.detail:
Meta於2026年9月底正式推出面向中小企業的Muse AI套裝，並於近期公開了三大核心商業應用場景的具體操作細節。這些場景並非停留在概念層面，而是已有大量SMB用戶實際採用的高頻使用模式，對代理商而言具有重要的示範與競爭參考價值。

第一個場景是廣告成效評估查詢，亦是目前使用頻率最高的功能。企業主可以自然語言直接向Muse提問，例如「分析我的Meta廣告，哪些表現最好，原因是什麼？」或「有什麼主要建議可以改善我的廣告成效？」這類查詢過去需要開啟Ads Manager、手動篩選報表、再作人工分析解讀，現在Muse可直接提供綜合分析，大幅降低廣告主自助管理的操作門檻。對代理商的影響是雙面的：一方面，客戶自行查詢的能力提升，可能壓縮報告解讀服務的附加價值空間；另一方面，代理商亦可善用同一工具加速內部分析效率。

第二個場景是對話式廣告活動建立。用戶可以上傳創意簡報，再透過對話指引完成廣告系列架構設定，Muse會根據現有素材與目標提出建議。更關鍵的是第三個場景——跨平台自動化行銷漏斗。Muse透過與Shopify、Canva及HighLevel的原生連接器串聯，可執行從產品目錄分析、創意方向確定、廣告素材生成到廣告投放的完整流程。Pixel追蹤安裝支援也納入其中，意味著整個廣告技術堆疊的初始配置可在Muse環境內完成。

從技術架構角度審視，Muse的設計思路是將現有獨立工具（Ads Manager、商務管理器、第三方電商及設計平台）整合為一個自然語言介面，降低操作碎片化帶來的認知負擔。對香港代理商而言，這意味著部分基礎廣告操作服務的邊界正在被系統性侵蝕——尤其是針對中小企業客戶的廣告設定、報告解讀及基礎優化建議等環節。與此同時，代理商若能率先掌握Muse的完整能力，反而可作為工具優勢向客戶展示——示範如何透過Shopify整合實現商品上架至廣告投放的端對端自動化，是一個可立即轉化為客戶提案的具體工作流程。

值得留意的是，Muse目前的三大場景均以SMB為主要對象，其自然語言查詢能力仍受限於Meta廣告生態系統的數據邊界，無法整合Google Analytics、第三方歸因工具或客戶端自有CRM數據。代理商在跨渠道全局視角及複雜歸因策略上，仍具有難以被平台工具替代的專業優勢。關鍵的競爭策略在於：主動將Muse定位為代理商服務效率的擴大器，而非視之為對代理角色的威脅。
items.detail_en:
Meta officially launched its Muse AI package for small and medium businesses in late September 2026, and has since published detailed breakdowns of three core commercial use cases. These are not conceptual blueprints — they represent high-frequency usage patterns already adopted by large numbers of SMB users, making them directly relevant competitive reference points for agencies.

The first and most frequently used scenario is ad performance assessment. Business owners can query Muse in natural language — asking 'Analyze my Meta ads. What are my highest performing ads and why?' or 'What are top recommendations to improve my Meta ads performance?' — and receive synthesized analysis without opening Ads Manager or manually parsing reports. The implications for agencies cut both ways: clients' ability to self-serve analysis may compress the perceived value of routine reporting interpretation services, while agencies themselves can use the same tool to accelerate internal analysis workflows.

The second scenario is conversational campaign building, where users upload a creative brief and receive dialogue-guided recommendations for campaign structure based on available assets and objectives. More strategically significant is the third scenario: cross-platform automated marketing funnels. Via native connectors to Shopify, Canva, and HighLevel, Muse can execute a complete sequence — analyzing product catalogs, determining creative direction, generating ad assets, and launching campaigns. Pixel tracking installation support is also included, meaning the initial configuration of an entire ad tech stack can be completed within the Muse environment.

Architecturally, Muse is designed to consolidate what were previously fragmented tools — Ads Manager, Business Manager, third-party e-commerce and design platforms — into a single natural language interface, reducing the cognitive overhead of context-switching across systems. For Hong Kong agencies, this signals a systematic erosion of the baseline service boundary for SMB clients, particularly in the areas of campaign setup, reporting interpretation, and basic optimization recommendations. At the same time, agencies that proactively master Muse's full capability can position it as a tool differentiator — demonstrating Shopify-integrated end-to-end automation from product listing to ad delivery is a workflow that can be immediately converted into a client proposal.

It is worth noting that Muse's current three use cases are primarily SMB-oriented, and its natural language query capability remains bounded by Meta's own advertising ecosystem data. It cannot integrate Google Analytics, third-party attribution tools, or client-side CRM data. Agencies retain a meaningful professional advantage in cross-channel perspective and complex attribution strategy that platform-native tools cannot yet replicate. The critical competitive positioning is to proactively frame Muse as an amplifier of agency service efficiency, rather than treating it as a threat to the agency role.

items.title: Amazon 以 TNF 向品牌推出雙軌媒體策略，串流加零售數據閉環
items.title_en: Amazon's TNF Two-Pronged Pitch: Streaming Reach for Non-Endemics, Closed-Loop Attribution for Brands
items.summary: Amazon 以周四夜足球向非亞馬遜品牌提供全國運動觸達，同時為站內品牌打通廣告曝光至購買數據閉環，本季廣告主數量按年增長 6%，第四週收視按年升 19%。
items.summary_en: Amazon's TNF pitch offers non-endemic brands national sports reach and endemic brands closed-loop attribution from ad exposure to on-site purchases. Advertiser count grew 6%; Week 4 viewership rose 19% year-over-year.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Amazon 以串流加零售數據閉環重塑電視廣告邏輯，代理商媒體規劃需重新評估 Prime Video 運動內容的全漏斗價值。
items.why_en: Amazon's closed-loop sports media model challenges traditional TV planning — evaluate Prime Video sports as a full-funnel buy.
highlights: TNF 廣告主按年增長 6%，第四週收視按年升 19%，Amazon 串流運動內容的市場吸引力持續提升。
非亞馬遜品牌可透過 TNF 獲取全國運動受眾觸達；站內品牌則可享有廣告曝光直連至站內購買的數據閉環。
與傳統電視廣告相比，Amazon TNF 的差異化優勢在於站內購買數據的直接歸因，而非單純的收視率規模。
highlights_en: TNF advertiser count grew 6% this season; Week 4 viewership rose 19% year-over-year, demonstrating growing appeal of Amazon's streaming sports content.
Non-Amazon brands access national sports audiences through TNF; endemic brands gain direct closed-loop attribution from ad exposure to on-site purchases.
Amazon TNF's competitive edge over traditional TV is direct purchase attribution from its retail data, not just reach scale.
items.detail:
Amazon的週四橄欖球之夜（Thursday Night Football）已進入第四個賽季，相關廣告策略的成熟度顯著提升。本賽季廣告主數量按年增長6%，自2022年起已有逾80個品牌首次投放TNF，其中54個品牌為Amazon廣告生態系統的全新客戶——這一數字揭示了體育直播在Amazon廣告業務拓客層面的戰略作用，遠超單純的收視變現邏輯。第4週對陣數據（匹茲堡鋼人對克里夫蘭布朗）創下Prime Video同期最高收視紀錄，較2025年同週按年上升19%，顯示體育直播在串流媒體平台的黏著力持續強化。

Amazon向廣告主展示的是一套雙軌提案：針對非Amazon生態品牌（Non-Endemic）與Amazon賣家品牌（Endemic）各有截然不同的價值主張。以美國運通為代表的非自有生態品牌，TNF充當其進入Amazon廣告網絡及DSP的「入口」——品牌可先以體育場景測試平台效能，再將成功學習轉移至更廣泛的DSP投放策略。這一路徑特別吸引過去因預算門檻而迴避傳統廣播體育的中型品牌，例如高露潔（Colgate）——該品牌已逾七年未在超級碗投放廣告，卻在TNF找到了可接受的全國規模入場成本。

閉環歸因是Amazon廣告體系在體育場景下最具差異化的能力。高露潔在2025年TNF賽季的實測數據清晰呈現了這一優勢：透過Amazon第一方數據對曾曝光TNF廣告的用戶進行再定向，配合購物場景中的零售相關素材，最終帶動購買率提升8倍、品牌搜尋量翻倍、品牌知曉度提升3個百分點。傳統廣播電視難以提供此類從上漏斗曝光到下漏斗購買行為的連結性驗證，Amazon的第一方零售數據在此形成了結構性壁壘。

對香港代理商及服務零售、快消品（CPG）、電商客戶的媒介規劃師而言，這一動向具有直接的策略啟示。Prime Video體育廣告已不再是單純的品牌觸達工具，而是一個可連通全漏斗效果的媒體購買組合——上漏斗的大規模覆蓋與下漏斗的歸因轉化在同一平台閉環實現。這與傳統電視買位邏輯（曝光終止於播出，效果需借助第三方研究估算）有本質差異。代理商在媒介規劃提案中，應將Prime Video體育庫存重新定類，作為CPG及電商客戶媒介組合的全漏斗選項加以評估，而非僅將其視為品牌曝光的補充渠道。

需要保持清醒的是，Horizon Media的媒介專家指出，TNF廣告對地區分銷有限或屬高考量購買決策的品牌存在相當程度的「浪費」。全國規模媒體買位的價值，高度取決於廣告主的地理覆蓋能力與產品轉化周期。代理商在引用高露潔案例時，應評估客戶的地理分銷覆蓋與產品類別特性是否與閉環歸因模型的前提條件相符，避免將個案成效直接套用至不同類別客戶的媒介提案。
items.detail_en:
Amazon's Thursday Night Football (TNF) has entered its fourth season, with the maturity of its advertising strategy now clearly visible. Advertiser count grew 6% year-over-year this season, with more than 80 brands new to TNF since 2022 — of which 54 were entirely new to Amazon's advertising ecosystem. This figure reveals that live sports on Prime Video functions as a significant new-client acquisition channel for Amazon's ad business, well beyond the logic of monetizing viewership alone. The Week 4 matchup (Pittsburgh Steelers vs. Cleveland Browns) set a Prime Video record for that time slot, up 19% year-over-year versus the comparable 2025 Week 4 game, confirming that live sports is strengthening its hold on streaming audiences.

Amazon's pitch to advertisers is a two-pronged proposition with distinct value narratives for non-endemic and endemic brands respectively. For non-Amazon-ecosystem brands like American Express, TNF serves as a gateway into Amazon's broader ad network and DSP — enabling brands to test platform capabilities in a high-profile sports context before scaling learnings into wider DSP strategies. This path is particularly attractive to mid-sized brands priced out of traditional broadcast sports, such as Colgate, which had not run a Super Bowl campaign in over seven years but found an acceptable entry cost for national-scale reach through TNF.

Closed-loop attribution is Amazon's most structurally differentiated capability in the sports advertising context. Colgate's 2025 TNF results illustrate this clearly: by retargeting users who had been exposed to TNF spots using Amazon's first-party data — and serving contextually relevant retail assets in shopping environments — the campaign drove purchase rates up 8x, doubled branded searches, and lifted brand awareness by 3 percentage points. Traditional broadcast television cannot provide this kind of verified connection between upper-funnel exposure and lower-funnel purchase behavior, and Amazon's first-party retail data creates a structural moat that streaming competitors without e-commerce infrastructure cannot easily replicate.

For Hong Kong agencies serving retail, CPG, and e-commerce clients, this development carries direct strategic implications for media planning. Prime Video sports inventory should no longer be categorized solely as a brand awareness vehicle — it represents a full-funnel media buy in which large-scale upper-funnel reach and lower-funnel attributable conversion close within the same platform ecosystem. This is fundamentally different from traditional TV buying logic, where exposure ends at broadcast and effectiveness must be estimated through third-party research. Media planners should reclassify Prime Video sports as a full-funnel option in proposals for CPG and e-commerce clients, rather than treating it as a supplementary brand awareness channel.

A critical caveat worth maintaining: Horizon Media's buying specialist noted that TNF carries significant waste for brands with limited geographic distribution or products involving high-consideration purchase decisions. The value of a national-scale media buy is highly dependent on the advertiser's geographic coverage capability and product conversion cycle. When referencing the Colgate case study, agencies should assess whether client distribution footprint and product category characteristics are compatible with the preconditions of the closed-loop attribution model, rather than directly transposing case-study results to clients in different categories.

items.title: Target 視 TikTok 聲量為選品信號，主動引入爆款品牌 Mellow Sleep
items.title_en: Target Uses TikTok Social Proof as Product Selection Signal, Proactively Onboards Mellow Sleep
items.summary: Target 主動接洽 TikTok 頭部睡眠品牌 Mellow Sleep 並引入 550 間門店，首年收入 1.3 億美元，以社群聲量作選品預測信號，應對家居品類連續三年銷售下跌超過十億美元的困局。
items.summary_en: Target proactively onboarded TikTok sleep brand Mellow Sleep into 550 stores, generating $130M in year one. Target uses social proof as a product discovery signal to reverse three consecutive years of $1B+ home category declines.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 零售商以社媒聲量選品，直接強化了品牌在 TikTok 建立聲量的商業必要性，可作社媒投資 ROI 論述素材。
items.why_en: Retailers using social proof as a product signal strengthens the ROI case for brand TikTok investment — use this as a pitch argument.
highlights: Target 主動聯繫 TikTok 上有機爆紅的 Mellow Sleep，而非等待品牌申請，代表零售商的選品策略已轉向社媒聲量優先。
Mellow Sleep 首年錄得 1.3 億美元收入，第二年預計突破 3 億美元，驗證了社媒驅動零售分發模式的商業可行性。
此案例可作為代理商向消費品牌客戶說明社媒投資直接帶動零售鋪貨的具體論據。
highlights_en: Target proactively reached out to Mellow Sleep after it went viral on TikTok organically, signaling that retailer product selection is now driven by social media proof.
Mellow Sleep generated $130M in year one and projects $300M+ in year two, validating the commercial viability of social-to-retail distribution.
This case provides a concrete ROI argument for brand clients on how social media investment directly drives retail shelf placement.
items.detail:
Target引入TikTok爆款品牌Mellow Sleep的案例，提供了一個具體的數據基礎，支撐社交媒體聲量直接影響零售選品決策這一近年廣泛討論的命題。值得特別關注的，不是Mellow Sleep主動接觸Target尋求上架，而是Target的採購員主動找上門——彼時距品牌創立不足一年。這一採購方向的逆轉，在傳統零售邏輯中極為罕見，折射出TikTok社交聲量作為需求信號的即時性與可信度，已足以驅動大型零售商的選品判斷，無需等待線下銷售數據的驗證。

Mellow Sleep的商業成績為上述邏輯提供了量化支撐。品牌第一年達成1.3億美元收入，第二年預計突破3億美元，其支柱產品CloudAlign枕頭（定價39.99美元）與Marshmallow被（定價129.99美元）均在TikTok Shop長居暢銷榜首。Target的採購決策在時間上精準卡位：在品牌社交聲量達到高峰、消費者認知已形成的時機引入實體渠道，利用門店作為已建立需求的實體兌現場所，而非試圖透過上架行為本身創造需求。這一選品邏輯的核心是「社交驗證先行，零售轉化跟進」。

對Target而言，引入TikTok爆款品牌亦有其本業壓力的驅動邏輯。Target家居品類已連續三個財年出現逾10億美元的年度跌幅（2025財年跌幅達10.9億美元，按年下滑6.5%），傳統選品策略無法扭轉頹勢，而引入具有自帶流量的社交爆款品牌，是以最低媒體投入置換品類增量的一種結構性選擇。Mellow Sleep的獨家上架安排亦強化了Target的差異化定位，避免與其他零售商的直接比價競爭。

對香港代理商的策略意涵是多層次的。首先，TikTok社交聲量已從品牌傳播指標演變為商業決策輸入——能夠向客戶展示TikTok表現如何轉化為零售採購機會或分銷談判籌碼的代理商，在品牌與零售品類客戶中具有明顯的提案優勢。其次，零售媒體（Retail Media）的投入理由正從「配合零售商促銷」轉向「建立社交聲量以吸引零售渠道主動洽談」，這為品牌社交投資提供了一個在傳統ROI框架之外的長期戰略理由。

行業分析師Barry Thomas指出，消費者愈來愈傾向在實體店到訪之前，先透過社交媒體或AI搜尋確定目標產品的「氛圍或風格」，這意味著持續的數字聲量管理已成為線下零售轉化的前置條件。對代理商而言，此案例是一個可量化引用的真實論據：能夠在TikTok建立強大社交聲量的品牌，不只在平台上贏得銷量，更能吸引零售渠道主動招攬合作，形成線上線下協同增長的飛輪效應。
items.detail_en:
Target's adoption of TikTok-viral brand Mellow Sleep provides concrete data to underpin the proposition — widely discussed but previously short on hard evidence — that social media momentum directly influences retail buying decisions. What demands particular attention is not Mellow Sleep approaching Target to seek placement, but the reverse: Target's buyer proactively reached out to the brand less than a year after its founding. This inversion of traditional retail selection logic is uncommon in conventional buyer-vendor relationships, and it reveals that TikTok social proof has become sufficiently credible as a demand signal to drive major retailer buying decisions without waiting for physical sales data validation.

Mellow Sleep's commercial performance provides the quantitative grounding for this logic. The brand achieved $130 million in Year 1 revenue, with Year 2 projected to surpass $300 million. Its anchor products — the CloudAlign pillow at $39.99 and the Marshmallow Comforter at $129.99 — have consistently topped TikTok Shop bestseller charts. Target's timing was precise: entering with a physical channel at the moment of peak social proof, when consumer awareness was already established, using its stores as a physical redemption venue for already-formed demand rather than attempting to generate demand through shelf placement alone. The underlying selection logic is 'social validation first, retail conversion second.'

For Target, incorporating TikTok viral brands also reflects structural pressure in its own business. Target's home category has posted over $1 billion in annual declines for three consecutive fiscal years — a $1.09 billion drop in fiscal 2025, down 6.5% year-over-year. Traditional selection strategies have proven insufficient to reverse the trend. Bringing in social-native brands with built-in audience demand is a structural approach to generating category increments at minimal media investment. The exclusivity arrangement also reinforces Target's differentiation positioning, avoiding direct price comparison with other retailers.

The strategic implications for Hong Kong agencies are multi-layered. First, TikTok social proof has evolved from a brand communications metric into a commercial decision input — agencies that can demonstrate to clients how TikTok performance translates into retail procurement opportunities or distribution negotiation leverage hold a meaningful pitch advantage across brand and retail category clients. Second, the justification for retail media investment is shifting from 'supporting retailer promotions' toward 'building social proof to attract retail channels to initiate outreach,' providing brands with a long-term strategic rationale for social investment that operates outside the traditional immediate-ROI framework.

Analyst Barry Thomas noted that consumers increasingly determine their target product's 'look or vibe' via social media or AI search before a store visit — meaning sustained digital presence management has become a prerequisite for physical retail conversion, not a supplement to it. For agencies, this case study is a quantifiable real-world argument: brands that build strong TikTok social proof do not merely win platform sales — they attract retail channels to seek them out proactively, creating an online-to-offline compounding growth flywheel.

items.title: Ritson：Meta 正以新名稱向廣告主重售電視廣告舊邏輯
items.title_en: Ritson: Meta Is Repackaging Old TV Advertising Logic Under New Names
items.summary: Ritson 指 Meta 的廣告超脈衝、首印象廣告與 Reels 熱門廣告，本質上是電視爆破排期、首段廣告位及黃金時段的數位翻版，以新名稱高價重售。
items.summary_en: Ritson argues Meta's new Ads Super Burst, First Impression Ads, and Reels Trending Ads are digital repackagings of TV burst scheduling, first-position spots, and premium adjacency — sold at a premium after steering brands away from TV for years.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Meta 新產品需與傳統電視及 CTV 方案重新比較效益，代理商媒體建議書中的論述需要更新。
items.why_en: Meta's new formats require fresh cost-benefit analysis against TV and CTV — update media rationale for clients.
highlights: Meta 廣告超脈衝在短時間內集中曝光，與電視廣告的爆破排期策略在邏輯上完全一致。
首印象廣告與 Reels 熱門廣告分別對應傳統電視的首段廣告位與黃金時段節目搭配，以新名稱重新包裝銷售。
Ritson 認為此舉印證了品牌廣告的基本原則從未改變，AI 時代只是換了一個平台重新執行。
highlights_en: Meta's Ads Super Burst replicates TV burst scheduling logic, concentrating high-frequency exposures in a short window.
First Impression Ads and Reels Trending Ads correspond to TV first-position spots and premium programming adjacency, rebranded for social media.
Ritson argues this confirms that brand advertising fundamentals never changed — the AI era is simply re-executing them on a new platform.
items.detail:
行銷學者Mark Ritson在其最新分析文章中，對Meta近期推出的三項廣告新產品提出了一個尖銳的歷史性批判：這些以科技包裝的新格式，本質上是對電視廣告傳統手法的重新命名與重新販售，而Meta恰恰是近十年來最積極聲稱電視廣告已死的平台之一。

三項新產品各有其對應的電視廣告原型。「Ads Super Burst」允許品牌在3至24小時的時間窗口內在Meta平台進行獨家類別鎖定投放，Meta公布的中位數觸達數字為每次飛行3,400萬人次，廣告回憶提升接近3個百分點。Ritson指出，這正是廣告研究者Zielske於1959年便已記錄的集中式排期策略（burst scheduling）——集中曝光在單週內推動回憶率達63%，遠超分散排期。「First Impression Ads」每日為一個品牌獨家佔據所有用戶開啟Facebook時遇到的第一個廣告位，這直接對應電視商業時段中業界稱為「首位廣告」的首段廣告效益——TVision數據早已確認首段廣告持續優於後續廣告。「Reels Trending Ads」則將廣告緊排於當時最高觀看量的Reels內容之後，並配合節假日與體育賽季作時間性排期，複製的是電視廣告中「優質鄰接」（premium adjacency）的購買邏輯——即在高收視節目緊鄰位置投放，可追溯至1948年德士古石油贊助Milton Berle節目的歷史慣例。

 Ritson的核心論點是一個三步驟的策略性翻轉。第一步：Meta系統性地宣告電視廣告過時——祖克伯2007年聲稱媒體「每百年才改變一次」，Sandberg更直接稱「問題不是你能否不做電視廣告」；第二步：以效果廣告、點擊率追蹤等邏輯替代品牌建設，使廣告主在長達十年間轉移預算、削弱品牌資產積累；第三步：以全新名稱重新包裝集中排期、首位廣告位及優質鄰接，以溢價出售，並收取品牌廣告的費率。這一邏輯的隱含成本是廣告主在過渡期間流失的品牌資產，而這部分損失難以量化，更難以追討。

對香港代理商的啟示在於媒介規劃理由的更新需求。Meta上述新格式的運作原理並非新創，而是對已被驗證有效的傳統機制的數位化包裝，這意味著其效果主張有歷史研究支撐，具備可信度。代理商在面對客戶就「Meta新格式 vs. 傳統電視 / CTV」進行媒介比較時，不應以「創新性」作為投放理由，而應重新以受眾覆蓋成本、頻次控制能力、歸因精確度三個維度進行獨立評估——此時Meta的第一方數據優勢是真實存在的差異化，而非格式概念本身的新穎性。

從更宏觀的行業視野看，Ritson此文具有長遠參考價值。它提醒代理商在評估任何平台的「創新格式」時，應首先追問其本質機制是否已有效能記錄，而非被新命名所引導；在向客戶呈現媒介策略時，應以機制原理（集中排期、首位效應、優質鄰接）代替格式品牌名稱作為說理基礎，這不但使提案論述更為嚴謹，亦能在不同媒體渠道之間進行真正等價的效益比較，而非平台自我定義的比較框架。
items.detail_en:
Marketing scholar Mark Ritson's latest analysis delivers a pointed historical critique of Meta's three recently launched ad products: these technologically branded new formats are, in substance, renamed and resold versions of classical television advertising techniques — promoted by a platform that spent nearly a decade declaring TV advertising dead.

Each of the three products has a direct TV-era counterpart. 'Ads Super Burst' allows brands to reserve a 3-to-24-hour exclusive category window across Meta's platforms, with Meta reporting a median reach of 34 million per flight and nearly a 3-point lift in ad recall. Ritson identifies this as burst scheduling — a concentrated exposure strategy documented by researcher Zielske as far back as 1959, which drove weekly recall to 63%, far exceeding distributed schedules. 'First Impression Ads' gives one brand per day the exclusive first ad slot encountered by every user opening Facebook — a direct parallel to what the industry calls 'first position' in TV commercial breaks, with TVision data long confirming that first-break ads consistently outperform subsequent slots. 'Reels Trending Ads' places ads immediately after the most-watched Reels content, with seasonal scheduling tied to holidays and sports, replicating the TV buying discipline of premium adjacency — purchasing placement next to hit programming — traceable to Texaco's sponsorship of Milton Berle in 1948.

Ritson's core argument identifies a three-stage strategic reversal. Stage one: Meta systematically declared TV advertising obsolete — Zuckerberg in 2007 claiming media 'changes once every hundred years,' and Sandberg asserting 'the question is not if you can do without TV.' Stage two: replacing brand-building logic with performance advertising and click-tracking, guiding advertisers to reallocate budgets for over a decade and eroding brand equity accumulation in the process. Stage three: repackaging burst scheduling, first-position spots, and premium adjacency under new names at premium prices, now billing at brand advertising rates. The implicit cost is the brand equity lost by advertisers during the transition — a loss that is difficult to quantify and impossible to reclaim.

The implication for Hong Kong agencies lies in the need to update their media planning rationale. The operating principles behind Meta's new formats are not novel inventions — they are digitally packaged versions of historically validated mechanisms, which means their effectiveness claims carry the support of decades of empirical research. When presenting clients with a 'Meta new formats vs. traditional TV / CTV' media comparison, agencies should not use 'innovation' as a justification for investment. Instead, they should conduct an independent evaluation across three dimensions: cost of audience coverage, frequency control capability, and attribution precision — where Meta's first-party data advantage is a genuine and real differentiator, distinct from any novelty in the format concept itself.

From a broader industry perspective, Ritson's analysis holds lasting reference value. It reminds agencies that when evaluating any platform's 'innovative formats,' the first question should be whether the underlying mechanism has an established effectiveness record — rather than being guided by the naming. When presenting media strategy to clients, building the argument on mechanism principles (burst scheduling, first-position effects, premium adjacency) rather than platform-branded format names produces both more rigorous proposals and genuinely comparable cross-channel effectiveness assessments, rather than comparisons conducted within a platform's own definitional framework.

items.title: The Verge 重組受眾團隊備戰「Google 零流量」，訂閱成新增長引擎
items.title_en: The Verge Restructures Audience Team for 'Google Zero' Era, Subscriptions Become the New Growth Engine
items.summary: The Verge 放棄 SEO 主導的流量策略，設立電子報、社群及訂閱專職崗位，逾半新訂閱者現已直接導航而來，以直接讀者關係應對 AI 搜尋衝擊。
items.summary_en: The Verge is restructuring away from SEO toward direct reader relationships, creating specialist roles for newsletters, community, and subscriptions. Over half of new subscribers now navigate directly, modeling a publisher pivot for the AI search era.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: AI 搜尋侵蝕出版商參照流量，代理商需重新評估訂閱型媒體的受眾品質與廣告庫存穩定性。
items.why_en: As AI search erodes referral traffic, agencies must reassess subscription-led media inventory quality and stability.
highlights: The Verge 的重組針對 AI 搜尋取代 Google 有機流量的趨勢，將讀者獲取策略從被動 SEO 轉為主動社群建設。
逾半新訂閱者直接導航至訂閱頁面，顯示讀者忠誠度模式正在從演算法驅動轉向品牌主動選擇。
廣告庫存品質將出現分化：依賴 SEO 流量的媒體面臨持續不確定性，訂閱主導的媒體受眾忠誠度相對穩定。
highlights_en: The Verge's restructuring directly addresses AI search replacing Google organic referral traffic, shifting from passive SEO to active community building.
More than half of new subscribers navigate directly to sign up, signaling a shift from algorithm-driven discovery to brand-conscious reader choice.
Ad inventory quality will bifurcate: SEO-dependent media faces growing uncertainty, while subscription-led media offers more stable, loyal audiences.
items.detail:
The Verge 隸屬 Vox Media 旗下，近年面對 Google 搜尋演算法頻繁調整及 AI 生成內容大舉搶佔結果頁的雙重衝擊，有機搜尋流量持續萎縮。面對這一行業現實，該媒體選擇主動重組受眾運營團隊，逐步以職能專家取代過往的通才架構，並將整體增長策略的核心從搜尋引擎優化，轉移至訂閱制的直接讀者關係建立。值得注意的是，此次調整並無裁員，屬於擴編性的轉型，方向與同期削減人手的《今日美國》截然不同。

重組後的團隊設有數個全新專責崗位：電子報專員負責頂端漏斗的用戶獲取與電郵培育；兩名平台社群互動專員深耕用戶留存；一名新聞編輯室分析師則橫跨匿名訪客、已登記用戶及付費訂閱者三個受眾層級，追蹤各項內容表現指標。這種分層式的受眾運營邏輯，反映出 The Verge 正嘗試將每一個接觸點系統化地轉化為更深層的用戶關係，而非停留在頁面瀏覽量的表面數字。

The Verge 於 2024 年 12 月正式推出付費牆，訂閱模式目前已展現出顯著的直接導流特徵：超過五成的新訂閱者是直接進入訂閱頁面完成轉化，而非由搜尋結果引導而來。受眾與訂閱總監 Esther Cohen 指出，團隊成員現在各自持有清晰的個人增長目標，組織效率較以往明顯提升。與此同時，The Verge 也在電子報推廣、播客宣傳、網站廣告以及將獨家資訊主動向更大型媒體推送等多元渠道上持續投入，構建多觸點的自然流量網絡。

對廣告代理商而言，The Verge 的轉型具有直接的媒體採購參考價值。隨著 AI 搜尋侵蝕自然流量成為出版業的結構性趨勢，媒體資產的流量質素評估需要更為精細的框架：直接流量佔比、電子報訂閱規模、社群活躍度，將逐漸成為比純粹頁面瀏覽量更具預測力的媒體健康指標。依賴 SEO 維繫流量的出版商，在廣告主眼中的風險溢價將持續上升；反之，已建立穩固直接讀者關係的媒體，其版位價值與受眾黏性亦將獲得更高的認可。這一趨勢對評估媒體組合的廣告代理商而言，是值得提前納入採購決策框架的結構性訊號。
items.detail_en:
The Verge, part of Vox Media, has been navigating a dual pressure: frequent Google algorithm updates and AI-generated content increasingly dominating search result pages, both steadily eroding organic traffic. Rather than waiting for conditions to improve, the publication proactively restructured its audience operations team — replacing generalist roles with functional specialists and shifting its core growth strategy from search engine optimization toward building direct reader relationships through subscriptions. Notably, the restructuring involved no layoffs; it was an expansion rather than a contraction, setting it apart from contemporaries like USA Today that pursued headcount reductions in similar pivots.

The reorganized team introduced several new dedicated roles: a newsletter specialist focused on top-of-funnel acquisition and email nurturing; two platform and community engagement specialists concentrating on retention; and a newsroom analyst tracking content performance across three audience segments — anonymous visitors, registered users, and paying subscribers. This layered approach to audience operations reflects The Verge's ambition to systematically convert every touchpoint into a deeper reader relationship, moving beyond surface-level pageview metrics.

The Verge launched its paywall in December 2024, and the subscription model has already shown a meaningful direct-traffic characteristic: more than 50% of new subscribers arrive directly at the subscription page rather than through search referrals. Audience and Subscriptions Director Esther Cohen noted that team members now each hold individual growth targets, marking a significant shift in organizational accountability. The publication continues to invest across multiple organic distribution channels — newsletter promotion, podcast amplification, on-site advertising, and proactively pitching exclusives to larger outlets to expand reach.

For advertising agencies, The Verge's transformation carries direct implications for media planning and buying. As AI-driven search erodes organic traffic across the publishing industry — a structural trend rather than a temporary fluctuation — the quality assessment of media inventory requires more nuanced frameworks. Direct traffic share, newsletter subscriber base, and community engagement levels are becoming stronger predictors of media health than raw pageview counts. Publishers relying heavily on SEO to sustain their audiences carry increasing risk premium in advertiser evaluations, while those with established direct reader relationships command stronger recognition for inventory value and audience stickiness. This structural signal warrants early integration into agency media planning frameworks.

items.title: Kling AI 4.0 發布：30 秒影片、多語言唇語同步、MCP 代理整合
items.title_en: Kling AI 4.0 Launches: 30-Second Video, Multilingual Lip Sync, and MCP Agent Integration
items.summary: 快手旗下 Kling AI 4.0 支援最長 30 秒影片、10 種以上語言唇語同步、立體聲輸出及 4K HDR，並整合 MCP 與 CLI 以支援代理工作流程，輕量 Flash 版提供更低成本選項。
items.summary_en: Kling AI 4.0 supports up to 30-second video, multilingual lip sync across 10+ languages, stereo audio, 4K/1080p HDR, and MCP/CLI integration for agent-based workflows. A lighter Flash variant offers a lower-cost option.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: 多語言唇語同步直接提升跨市場影片廣告本地化效率，MCP 整合可接入現有廣告素材自動化管線。
items.why_en: Multilingual lip sync and MCP integration make Kling 4.0 directly actionable for cross-market video ad localization pipelines.
highlights: Kling AI 4.0 支援 10 種以上語言的唇語同步，大幅降低跨市場影片廣告本地化的製作成本與週期。
最長 30 秒影片生成，支援最多 15 個參考資源，並提供 4K 與 1080p HDR 兩種輸出規格。
MCP 與 CLI 整合允許代理工作流程直接呼叫 Kling，可嵌入廣告素材自動化管線，減少人工干預。
highlights_en: Kling AI 4.0 supports lip sync across 10+ languages, significantly reducing the cost and timeline for cross-market video ad localization.
Generation supports up to 30 seconds and 15 reference assets, with 4K and 1080p HDR output options.
MCP and CLI integration allows agent workflows to call Kling directly, enabling embedding in automated creative pipelines with reduced human intervention.
items.detail:
快手旗下 AI 影片生成工具 Kling AI 正式推出 4.0 版本，在核心能力上實現多項突破性升級，並以「Omni Reference」全參考系統為技術亮點之一。此版本單次生成時長上限提升至 30 秒，可接受最多 10 張關鍵幀圖片作為輸入素材，並支援長達 8,000 個 token 的提示詞解析，大幅擴展了創作者對複雜敘事場景的掌控能力。輸出規格方面，4K 與 1080p HDR 10-bit 高動態範圍影片支援已列入路線圖，正式上線後將進一步拉升素材品質門檻。

多語言唇語同步功能是 Kling 4.0 對廣告製作行業最具直接應用價值的功能之一。系統目前支援德語、英語、日語、韓語、西班牙語及多種方言在內的十種以上語言，並搭載雙聲道立體聲音訊輸出。對於需要跨亞太市場同步執行廣告投放的代理商而言，這意味著原始素材可以在不重新拍攝的前提下，透過 AI 唇語同步技術快速完成本地化改編，顯著壓縮製作週期與成本。「Creative Recreation」功能則進一步允許在現有影片中替換人物或產品，為創意資產的多版本管理提供新的可能性。

參考素材系統「Omni Reference」允許創作者同時輸入最多 15 個資產，涵蓋 10 張圖片、5 段影片（合計不超過 30 秒）及 7 個設計元素，並接受故事板、線框圖、深度圖等多種素材格式。影片延長功能預計將支援最長 2 分鐘的輸出，開放後將為廣告長片及品牌內容創作提供更寬裕的製作空間。輕量版「Kling 4.0 Flash」則針對速度與成本敏感的應用場景，以 720p 解析度及最長 20 秒的輸出換取更快的生成速度。

在工作流整合層面，Kling 4.0 通過 MCP（Model Context Protocol）與 CLI 接口開放 API 對接，使其能夠嵌入自動化代理工作流。對於希望在廣告素材生產管線中引入 AI 影片生成的代理商而言，這一整合能力意味著可以在現有技術架構內以程式化方式觸發素材生成、版本管理與多語言適配，而非依賴單一操作介面的人工作業。隨著 API 定價方案正式公布，大規模素材生產的成本結構將逐步清晰，屆時將是代理商評估是否將 Kling 納入製作工具鏈的關鍵時間節點。
items.detail_en:
Kuaishou's AI video generation tool Kling AI has officially launched version 4.0, delivering several breakthrough upgrades anchored by its "Omni Reference" comprehensive input system. The new version extends single-pass generation to up to 30 seconds, accepts up to 10 keyframe images as input, and processes prompts up to 8,000 tokens — substantially expanding creators' ability to direct complex narrative scenes. On the output side, 4K and 1080p HDR 10-bit high dynamic range video support is listed on the roadmap, and once live, will raise the quality ceiling for AI-generated production assets.

Multilingual lip sync stands out as one of Kling 4.0's most immediately actionable features for the advertising production industry. The system currently supports over ten languages including German, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and various regional dialects, paired with two-channel stereo audio output. For agencies executing campaigns simultaneously across Asia-Pacific markets, this means original footage can be localized rapidly through AI lip sync adaptation without reshooting — significantly compressing production timelines and costs. The "Creative Recreation" feature further enables character or product substitution within existing videos, opening new possibilities for multi-variant creative asset management.

The Omni Reference system allows creators to input up to 15 assets simultaneously — 10 images, 5 videos (totaling no more than 30 seconds), and 7 design elements — and accepts a wide range of formats including storyboards, wireframes, and depth maps. An upcoming video extension feature is expected to support outputs up to 2 minutes, which will provide more generous runtime for advertising long-form and branded content production. The lighter "Kling 4.0 Flash" variant trades resolution (capped at 720p) and duration (maximum 20 seconds) for faster generation speeds, targeting speed- and cost-sensitive use cases.

On the workflow integration front, Kling 4.0 exposes API access via MCP (Model Context Protocol) and CLI interfaces, enabling embedding within automated agent workflows. For agencies seeking to incorporate AI video generation into their creative asset production pipelines, this integration means video generation, version management, and multilingual adaptation can be triggered programmatically within existing technical architectures — rather than relying on manual operation through a single interface. Once API pricing is formally announced, the cost structure for large-scale asset production will become clearer, marking a critical evaluation point for agencies considering whether to integrate Kling into their production toolchain.

items.title: Publicis 亞太區 Q3 增長 5.4%，中國逆市飆升 10.6%
items.title_en: Publicis APAC Q3 Up 5.4%, China Surges 10.6% Against the Market
items.summary: Publicis Groupe 亞太區 Q3 有機增長 5.4%，中國錄得 10.6% 逆市增長，CEO Sadoun 指 AI 整合策略帶動全球創紀錄新業務，進一步拉開與 WPP 及 Omnicom 的差距。
items.summary_en: Publicis Groupe APAC posted 5.4% organic growth in Q3, with China surging 10.6%. CEO Sadoun credited AI integration for record new-business wins globally, widening the gap over WPP and Omnicom.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: Publicis 持續擴大市場份額，代理商要講清楚自己的 AI 整合替客戶省下什麼、做出什麼，才有機會在比稿中勝出。
items.why_en: Publicis continues gaining share — agencies must sharpen AI-integration pitches to compete in client reviews.
items.followup: 10 月 15 日我們報過 Publicis Q3 全球有機增長 5%，CEO Sadoun 以「三強鼎立格局對業務有利」定調競爭形勢。Campaign Asia 今日深入拆解亞太區數據——亞太增長 5.4%、中國更錄得 10.6%。值得注意的是，中國市場逆市大幅反彈，成為 Publicis AI 整合策略在大中華區說服力的最重要佐證；這條線從「全球增長」演變為「亞太如何領跑」。
