Today's Campaign Asia deep-dive shows APAC at 5.4% and China at 10.6%. Notably, China's sharp rebound is the strongest proof point for Publicis's AI integration strategy in Greater China — the story evolves from 'global growth' to 'how APAC is leading the charge.'
highlights: Publicis 亞太區 Q3 有機增長 5.4%，其中中國市場逆市錄得 10.6%，是全球主要市場中增速最高的地區。
CEO Sadoun 強調 AI 整合策略帶來全球新業務創歷史記錄，進一步拉開與 WPP 及 Omnicom 的差距。
此業績顯示客戶比稿時先看 AI 能力，只賣創意服務的代理商難以守住市場份額。
highlights_en: Publicis APAC organic growth reached 5.4% in Q3, with China surging 10.6% — the highest growth rate among all major markets.
CEO Sadoun cited record new-business wins globally driven by AI integration, widening the gap over WPP and Omnicom.
This result signals AI capability has become a core evaluation criterion in pitches — pure creative services struggle to maintain share in the current competitive landscape.
items.detail:
陽獅集團（Publicis Groupe）公布 2026 年第三季度業績，亞太區自然增長率達到 5.4%，在主要市場中，中國市場表現尤為突出，錄得 10.6% 的增長，印度亦實現雙位數增長。這一成績在全球宏觀環境仍存在相當不確定性的背景下顯得格外亮眼，也延續了集團整體 5% 有機增長的強勁勢頭。陽獅管理層將這一表現歸因於AI整合能力的持續深化，以及由此帶動的新業務獲取紀錄突破。

值得注意的是，中國市場 10.6% 的增長是在消費信心疲弱、廣告主整體預算趨於保守的宏觀逆風下取得的。這一數字顯示陽獅在中國的客戶組合及業務定位具有較強的抗周期韌性，或與其在數位化轉型及 AI 行銷應用方面向本土客戶提供的專業服務有關。與此同時，印度市場的雙位數增長同樣印證了亞太區作為陽獅全球增長引擎的持續重要性。

陽獅此番業績公布的背景，是集團層面持續拉大與 WPP 及埃培智（Omnicom）之間的差距。多方分析指出，AI 能力已從行銷傳播行業的概念敘事，演變為實質性影響客戶招標結果的競爭要素。陽獅在 Marcel 平台及一系列 AI 工具上的長期投入，正在轉化為可量化的新業務贏取優勢，令競爭對手的跟進壓力顯著上升。

對香港及亞太區廣告代理商而言，陽獅的表現傳遞出明確的市場訊號：AI 整合能力已成為客戶選擇代理商夥伴時的重要考量維度，而非附加項目。代理商若未能在提案中清晰呈現 AI 在效率提升、受眾洞察或創意生產方面的具體應用，將在與具備成熟 AI 工具鏈的競爭對手的比稿中持續處於劣勢。這一競爭格局的演變速度，已超出部分中型代理商的預期應對節奏，值得業界提早正視並加速能力建設。
items.detail_en:
Publicis Groupe reported its Q3 2026 results, with the Asia-Pacific region recording 5.4% organic growth. Among key markets, China delivered an especially strong 10.6% increase, while India also achieved double-digit growth. These figures stand out against a backdrop of considerable global macroeconomic uncertainty, and extend the group's overall organic growth momentum of 5%. Publicis management attributed the performance to deepening AI integration capabilities and a record run of new business wins driven by those capabilities.

China's 10.6% growth is particularly notable given the headwinds of subdued consumer confidence and generally cautious advertiser budgets across the market. This figure suggests Publicis's client mix and market positioning in China carries meaningful counter-cyclical resilience, likely connected to the specialized services it provides to local clients in digital transformation and AI marketing applications. India's double-digit growth further reinforces Asia-Pacific's sustained importance as a key growth engine within Publicis's global portfolio.

The results were published against the backdrop of Publicis continuing to widen its gap over WPP and Omnicom at the group level. Multiple analyst perspectives point to AI capability having evolved from a conceptual narrative in the marketing communications industry into a competitive factor with tangible impact on client pitch outcomes. Publicis's long-term investments in its Marcel platform and a suite of AI tools are now translating into measurable new business advantages, placing meaningful pressure on competitors to accelerate their own AI integration programs.

For Hong Kong and Asia-Pacific agencies, Publicis's performance sends a clear market signal: AI integration capability has become a substantive criterion in client partner selection rather than an optional feature. Agencies that cannot clearly articulate specific AI applications — in efficiency gains, audience insight, or creative production — within their proposals will face continued disadvantage against competitors with mature AI toolchains. The pace at which this competitive dynamic is shifting has outrun the response timelines of some mid-tier agencies, making early recognition and accelerated capability building a pressing priority for the sector.

items.title: Accenture 傳評估以 15 億美元出售大中華區業務
items.title_en: Accenture Reportedly Weighing US$1.5 Billion Sale of Greater China Operations
items.summary: Accenture 委託摩根大通評估以 15 億美元出售大中華區（大陸、香港、台灣）業務的可行性，主因是中國安全法規收緊及投資者要求聚焦 AI 核心業務。
items.summary_en: Accenture has engaged JPMorgan to review a potential sale of its Greater China operations for up to US$1.5 billion, driven by tightening Chinese security regulations and investor pressure to focus on AI-driven core business.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 外資諮詢集團撤出大中華區具指標意義，港台代理商可評估潛在的客戶資源與人才轉移機遇。
items.why_en: A major consulting group exiting Greater China is significant — HK agencies should monitor client displacement and talent opportunities.
highlights: Accenture 大中華區業務涵蓋中國大陸、香港及台灣，潛在出售規模最高達 15 億美元，潛在買家目前尚未確定。
撤退的直接原因是中國安全法規收緊，以及投資者要求 Accenture 聚焦 AI 驅動的核心諮詢業務。
外資諮詢集團逐步退出中國市場的趨勢若持續，本地代理商與技術服務商可能承接部分被移交的客戶業務。
highlights_en: Accenture's Greater China operations cover mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, with a potential sale value of up to US$1.5 billion; the buyer has not been identified.
The direct drivers are tightening Chinese security regulations and investor demands for Accenture to focus on AI-driven core consulting business.
If the trend of foreign consulting groups exiting China continues, local agencies and tech service providers may absorb displaced client business.
items.detail:
據市場消息，埃森哲（Accenture）已委聘摩根大通（JPMorgan）對其大中華區業務進行戰略評估，探討潛在出售可能性，相關業務覆蓋中國內地、香港及台灣，估值上限據報達 15 億美元。觸發此次評估的直接原因，在於埃森哲過去一年持續收到外部的非主動收購意向，疊加投資者就集團 AI 戰略聚焦方向施加的壓力，促使管理層啟動正式的策略審視流程。

從監管環境角度而言，近年中國收緊數據安全法規，要求外資科技與諮詢服務企業在本土數據存儲及系統架構上作出大規模合規調整，亦使跨境業務的整合協同效益愈發難以維持。埃森哲面臨在本土合規投入與全球業務架構之間進行取捨的結構性壓力，此次出售評估部分源於這一長期存在的張力。潛在買家方面，據報以私募股權基金及少數策略性買家為主，埃森哲亦可能保留少數股權，以確保客戶服務的延續性。

值得注意的是，此次評估結果仍存在相當不確定性，亦有可能在未能找到合適買家的情況下不了了之。與此同時，埃森哲預期未來約兩年內收入增長將維持偏弱態勢，中期加速的核心邏輯正是押注於 AI 相關服務需求的規模化啟動。若出售大中華區業務的計劃成真，所得資金預計將投入 AI 能力收購、股份回購、派息以及在競爭性定價上的讓利空間，進一步鞏固其在全球 AI 諮詢市場的定位。

對香港市場的行銷及諮詢行業而言，埃森哲大中華區業務的潛在易主具有多層面的影響值得關注。其一，埃森哲在港的現有客戶或面臨服務連續性的不確定性，尤其在數位轉型及整合行銷科技專案方面，可能出現的服務真空為其他代理商及顧問公司提供了客戶承接的窗口期。其二，人才市場層面，大型架構調整往往觸發資深顧問人員的流動，對人才獲取具有積極意義。這一動態在香港本地行銷服務生態的影響，值得業界持續追蹤。
items.detail_en:
According to market reports, Accenture has engaged JPMorgan to conduct a strategic review of its Greater China business, exploring a potential sale covering mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan at a reported valuation of up to US$1.5 billion. The immediate catalyst for this review was unsolicited acquisition interest received over the past year, compounded by investor pressure on the group to sharpen its focus on its AI-driven consulting strategy — prompting management to initiate a formal strategic assessment process.

From a regulatory environment standpoint, China's tightening data security legislation in recent years has required foreign technology and consulting firms to undertake large-scale compliance adjustments to local data storage and system architectures, making cross-border operational synergies increasingly difficult to sustain. Accenture faces structural pressure to balance domestic compliance investment against its global operating framework, and the sale review partly reflects this long-standing tension. On the buyer side, private equity firms and a limited number of strategic buyers have been identified as the primary prospects; Accenture may also retain a significant minority stake to preserve client service continuity.

It is important to note that considerable uncertainty remains around the outcome of this review, and the process may conclude without a transaction if a suitable buyer cannot be identified. Separately, Accenture has projected subdued revenue growth for approximately the next two years, with the medium-term acceleration thesis centered on the scaling of AI-related services demand. Should the Greater China sale materialize, proceeds are expected to be directed toward AI capability acquisitions, share buybacks, dividends, and competitive client pricing flexibility — further reinforcing the group's positioning in the global AI consulting market.

For Hong Kong's marketing and consulting sector, the potential ownership change of Accenture's Greater China operations carries implications across multiple dimensions. Existing Accenture clients in Hong Kong, particularly those in active digital transformation or integrated marketing technology engagements, may face service continuity uncertainty — a window that other agencies and consulting firms could leverage for client relationship development. On the talent side, major structural transitions of this scale typically trigger movement among senior consulting professionals, presenting meaningful talent acquisition opportunities. The downstream effects on Hong Kong's local marketing services ecosystem warrant continued monitoring by industry participants.

items.title: Billion Dollar Boy 收購 B2B 創作者代理商，押注 LinkedIn 行銷下一波浪潮
items.title_en: Billion Dollar Boy Acquires B2B Creator Agency, Betting LinkedIn Marketing Is Creator's Next Wave
items.summary: Billion Dollar Boy 收購 LinkedIn 專注 B2B 創作者代理商 Creator Authority，客戶含 Amazon、Adobe 及 IBM，B2B 創作者行銷現時僅五分之一決策者已投入，集團目標明年收入突破 1 億美元。
items.summary_en: Billion Dollar Boy acquired LinkedIn-focused B2B creator agency Creator Authority, adding Amazon, Adobe, and IBM as clients. Only one-fifth of marketing decision-makers invest in B2B creator marketing today; BDB targets $100M+ revenue next year.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: B2B 創作者行銷滲透率低、市場增長快，代理商可主動向企業客戶提案 LinkedIn 創作者策略以搶先佔位。
items.why_en: B2B creator marketing is underpenetrated and growing fast — agencies can pitch LinkedIn creator strategies to enterprise clients to gain first-mover advantage.
highlights: 調查顯示僅五分之一行銷決策者已投入 B2B 創作者行銷，59% 的 B2B 買家表示關注 LinkedIn 創作者內容。
Creator Authority 的客戶名單涵蓋 Amazon、Adobe、IBM 與 Mastercard，反映頭部科技與金融品牌已率先布局 LinkedIn 創作者策略。
B2B 創作者代理商的收購整合，預示這一細分賽道正從分散走向集中，進入窗口正在縮窄。
highlights_en: Only one-fifth of marketing decision-makers have invested in B2B creator marketing, yet 59% of B2B buyers pay attention to LinkedIn creator content.
Creator Authority's client roster includes Amazon, Adobe, IBM, and Mastercard — leading tech and finance brands are already investing in LinkedIn creator strategies.
The consolidation of B2B creator agencies signals this niche is shifting from fragmented to concentrated — the entry window is narrowing.
items.detail:
英國網紅行銷集團 Billion Dollar Boy（BDB）宣布收購 Creator Authority，後者是一家總部位於加州聖塔莫尼卡、成立三年的 B2B 創作者行銷代理商，以 LinkedIn 為核心作戰平台。Creator Authority 服務的客戶涵蓋 Amazon、Adobe、IBM、Mastercard、AT&T、HubSpot、Dropbox、Notion 等科技與企業軟體巨頭，客戶組合的深度印證了 B2B 創作者行銷作為獨立業務分支的可行性。收購金額未有披露，交易已完成。

Creator Authority 聯合創辦人 Brendan Gahan 將出任 BDB 集團 B2B 業務高級副總裁，另一位聯合創辦人 Cassie Jackson 則擔任 B2B 業務組客戶總監，駐守德克薩斯州奧斯汀。這項收購同時標誌著 BDB 的美國業務版圖由紐約延伸至西岸，在地理覆蓋上進一步完善。BDB 集團執行長 Ed East 將 B2B 創作者行銷定位為整個創作者經濟中「最具重要性的增長機遇之一」，並表示集團明年的目標是突破 1 億美元全球收入。

驅動這宗收購的市場背景數據同樣引人關注。根據針對英美兩地 1,000 名行銷決策者的調查，59% 的 B2B 採購決策者會主動關注 LinkedIn 上的創作者內容，然而目前僅有約五分之一（20%）的行銷決策者在本年度對 B2B 創作者行銷有所投入。這一巨大的認知與行動落差，正是 BDB 判斷市場滲透空間仍然充裕的核心依據。此外，在整個創作者經濟的投資優先排序中，B2B 創作者行銷的重要性已位列第二，顯示業界對這一賽道的關注度正快速升溫。

BDB 執行長亦特別點出一個新興的戰略維度：創作者生產的 B2B 內容不僅在 LinkedIn 上直接影響人工受眾，同時也在 AI 聊天機器人的推薦結果中扮演日益重要的角色。隨著企業採購決策者越來越多地借助 AI 工具篩選供應商資訊，在 AI 可索引的公開平台上建立具影響力的創作者內容矩陣，將成為 B2B 品牌搜尋可見度的新競爭維度。對香港代理商而言，在競爭尚未白熱化之前，率先向企業客戶提出 LinkedIn 創作者策略，將是一個值得把握的先發機遇。
items.detail_en:
UK-based influencer marketing group Billion Dollar Boy (BDB) has announced the acquisition of Creator Authority, a three-year-old B2B creator marketing agency headquartered in Santa Monica, California, with LinkedIn as its primary operating platform. Creator Authority's client roster includes technology and enterprise software heavyweights such as Amazon, Adobe, IBM, Mastercard, AT&T, HubSpot, Dropbox, and Notion — a portfolio depth that validates B2B creator marketing as a viable standalone business practice. Financial terms were not disclosed; the transaction has already been completed.

Creator Authority co-founder Brendan Gahan will become SVP of B2B at BDB Group, while co-founder Cassie Jackson takes on the role of Group Account Director for B2B, based in Austin, Texas. The acquisition also extends BDB's U.S. presence from New York to the West Coast, completing a broader geographic footprint. BDB Group CEO Ed East positioned B2B creator marketing as "one of the most significant growth opportunities" in the entire creator economy, with the group targeting over $100 million in global revenue next year.

The market data underpinning this acquisition is equally compelling. According to a survey of 1,000 marketing decision-makers across the US and UK, 59% of B2B purchasing decision-makers actively follow creator content on LinkedIn — yet only approximately one in five (20%) marketing decision-makers invested in B2B creator marketing this year. This substantial gap between awareness and action is the core basis for BDB's assessment that market penetration remains highly accessible. Furthermore, B2B creator marketing has risen to second place in the investment priority rankings across the broader creator economy, signaling rapidly accelerating industry attention to this segment.

BDB's CEO also highlighted an emerging strategic dimension: creator-produced B2B content not only influences human audiences directly on LinkedIn, but is increasingly shaping AI chatbot recommendation results. As enterprise procurement decision-makers rely more heavily on AI tools to screen vendor information, building an influential creator content matrix on AI-indexable public platforms is becoming a new competitive dimension for B2B brand search visibility. For Hong Kong agencies, proactively proposing LinkedIn creator strategies to enterprise clients before competition intensifies represents a first-mover opportunity worth seizing.

items.title: AI 搜尋衝擊到達臨界點：獨立報社交電商首超 SEO 電商，傳統流量模式已死
items.title_en: AI Search Reaches Tipping Point: The Independent's Social Commerce Surpasses SEO Commerce
items.summary: 《獨立報》CEO 披露社交電商收入首次超越 SEO 電商收入，原因並非社交增長，而是 AI 導致搜尋流量驟降。AdExchanger 評論稱傳統發布商流量模式已死。
items.summary_en: The Independent's CEO revealed social commerce revenue surpassed SEO-driven commerce for the first time — not from social growth, but from AI-driven search traffic collapse. AdExchanger declared the traditional publisher traffic model 'dead.'
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 依賴 SEO 流量的品牌客戶須認真考慮將預算轉向社交電商與 AI 搜尋優化（GEO）。
items.why_en: Brand clients relying on SEO traffic should reallocate budgets toward social commerce and GEO (generative engine optimization).
items.pattern: AI 搜尋對有機流量的侵蝕速度已超過多數發布商的預期。從《獨立報》的數據推斷，主要媒體的 SEO 流量在 2027 年前降幅超過三成是大概率事件。代理商現在布局 GEO 服務，恰好可以在需求爆發時搶到先機。
items.pattern_en: AI search is eroding organic traffic faster than most publishers anticipated. Based on The Independent's data, major media SEO traffic declining 30%+ before 2027 is probable. Agencies building GEO capabilities now will be positioned exactly when client demand peaks.
highlights: 《獨立報》社交電商收入首次超越 SEO 電商收入，印證 AI 搜尋對出版商有機流量的破壞已達臨界點。
AdExchanger 稱傳統發布商的流量模式已死，從 SEO 到社交的過渡期流量缺口正在加速擴大。
代理商可據此重新整理客戶的渠道組合優先次序，將社交電商與生成式引擎優化納入核心媒體計劃。
highlights_en: The Independent's social commerce revenue surpassing SEO commerce confirms that AI search's destruction of publisher organic traffic has reached a tipping point.
AdExchanger declared the traditional publisher traffic model dead; the transition gap from SEO to social is accelerating.
Agencies can use this to reframe client channel mix priorities, positioning social commerce and GEO as core media plan elements.
items.detail:
《獨立報》（The Independent）行政總裁 Christian Broughton 在 Digiday 倫敦媒體策略峰會上披露，社交電商收益於上月首次超越搜尋引擎優化（SEO）驅動的電商收益——這是該媒體集團發展史上的一個重要轉捩點。值得注意的是，Broughton 的表述措辭謹慎：《獨立報》不公開具體收益分拆數字，因此外界難以判斷這究竟代表社交渠道的主動增長，還是 SEO 電商基數在 AI 衝擊下萎縮後所產生的相對超越。

AdExchanger 的分析傾向後者。其報道明確指出，此次「首超」背後的主要驅動力，是人工智能驅動的搜尋流量急劇萎縮，而非社交商業本身的突飛猛進。隨著 ChatGPT、Perplexity 等 AI 搜尋工具持續分食傳統搜尋引擎的使用量，透過 Google 等平台導入內容頁面的有機流量正在系統性地下滑；依賴聯署行銷（affiliate）與 SEO 帶動購買轉化的媒體收益模式，其根基因此被動搖。與此同時，Broughton 亦主動宣告，傳統出版商靠購買或爭取搜尋、社交流量再以廣告變現的舊有模式，已告終結。

為此，《獨立報》已識別出四大替代收益支柱，預計今年合計將超越整體收益的一半：人工智能授權與合作、由創作者主導的製作工作室業務、電子商務，以及訂閱會員制。這一轉型路徑折射出一個更廣泛的行業現實——媒體集團在流量紅利消退後，被迫重構商業邏輯，以深度服務取代廣告曝光，以直接關係取代平台中介。

對廣告代理商而言，此案例提供了兩層警示。其一，依賴 SEO 流量的客戶，其廣告投放效益正面臨結構性壓力，而這種壓力並非短期波動，而是 AI 搜尋崛起所帶來的長期格局改變。其二，社交電商渠道的相對優勢正在浮現，與此同時，生成式引擎優化（GEO，Generative Engine Optimization）亦逐漸成為品牌在 AI 搜尋時代維持可見度的核心策略。代理商若要維持對客戶的戰略價值，需要盡早將服務能力從傳統 SEO 導向，轉移至社交商業執行與 GEO 佈局，協助客戶在搜尋流量持續收縮的環境中建立新的觸達路徑。
items.detail_en:
The Independent CEO Christian Broughton disclosed at Digiday's Media Strategies event in London that social commerce revenue narrowly surpassed SEO-driven commerce revenue for the first time last month — a notable milestone in the publisher's history. However, Broughton's own framing warrants scrutiny: The Independent does not publicly disclose its revenue breakdown, leaving it genuinely ambiguous whether this crossover reflects authentic social commerce momentum or simply the collapse of the SEO commerce baseline under AI-driven search traffic decline.

AdExchanger's analysis leans toward the latter explanation. Its reporting characterizes the development as a consequence of a precipitous, AI-driven drop-off in search traffic rather than a social commerce triumph in its own right. As AI-powered search tools such as ChatGPT and Perplexity continue to displace traditional search engine usage, the organic traffic that once flowed through Google into publisher content pages is shrinking systemically. Revenue models built on affiliate commerce and SEO-driven conversions are losing their structural foundation as a result. Against this backdrop, Broughton explicitly declared that the traditional publisher model — acquiring search and social traffic then monetizing through advertising — is dead.

In its place, The Independent has identified four replacement revenue pillars expected to collectively surpass half of total revenue this year: AI licensing and partnerships, creator-led studio production work, e-commerce, and membership subscriptions. This strategic pivot reflects a broader industry reckoning: as traffic-driven economics deteriorate, publishers are being compelled to rebuild their commercial logic around depth of service, direct audience relationships, and platform-agnostic revenue streams.

For advertising agencies, this case carries two layers of implication. First, clients whose business models depend heavily on SEO-driven traffic are facing structural headwinds — not a temporary dip, but a durable shift resulting from the AI search transition. Second, social commerce channels are gaining relative standing precisely because the search alternatives are weakening, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is emerging as a critical discipline for brands seeking visibility in AI-mediated search environments. Agencies that recalibrate their service offering from traditional SEO toward social commerce execution and GEO strategy will be better positioned to deliver durable value as organic search traffic continues its structural decline.

items.title: 微軟：AI 代理猶如企業內部威脅，發布 Guardian Agents 安全監控機制
items.title_en: Microsoft: AI Agents Are Like Insider Threats — Launches Guardian Agents Security Framework
items.summary: 微軟安全主管宣稱「前沿模型無論來源均不可信」，發布 Guardian Agents 監控 AI 代理行為，Defender 新增約 60 種代理偵測，高風險操作需人工審批。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's security chief stated frontier AI models 'cannot be trusted' and launched Guardian Agents to monitor AI agent behavior. Defender can detect ~60 agent types; high-risk actions require human approval.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 向企業客戶部署 AI 代理的代理商應將安全管控框架納入方案，並以此作為差異化賣點。
items.why_en: Agencies deploying AI agents for enterprise clients should include security governance frameworks as a key differentiator.
highlights: 微軟明確表示前沿 AI 模型在企業環境中如同「內部威脅」，不論來源均須受到安全監控。
Guardian Agents 可偵測約 60 種不同類型的 AI 代理行為，高風險操作觸發人工審批流程。
CEO Nadella 強調需將「AI 的智能供應」與「執行授權」分開管理，代理商設計 AI 代理方案時需採納相同架構。
highlights_en: Microsoft explicitly positions frontier AI models as 'insider threats' in enterprise environments, requiring security monitoring regardless of model source.
Guardian Agents can detect approximately 60 types of AI agent behaviors, with high-risk actions triggering human approval workflows.
CEO Nadella emphasized separating 'intelligence supply' from 'action authorization' — agencies designing AI agent solutions should adopt the same governance architecture.
items.detail:
微軟安全業務負責人 Hayete Gallot 近日公開表示，無論 AI 模型來自哪家供應商，「前沿模型本質上不可信任」。她指出，這些模型的設計目標是完成任務，而非遵守企業內部規範或展現組織判斷力。這一表態將 AI 代理的安全威脅，從外部攻擊的視角，轉移到內部治理的框架之下——意味著企業必須把自己部署的 AI 代理，以對待「內部人威脅」同等的標準加以審視。

為此，微軟正式推出 Guardian Agents，作為 2026 年 6 月發布的 Project Perception 的延伸。原有框架已設立紅隊（模擬攻擊者）、藍隊（偵測弱點）與綠隊（修復漏洞）三個代理類別；Guardian Agents 的任務，是將監控範圍擴展至企業內部已部署的所有 AI 代理。與此同時，微軟 Defender 新增代理偵測功能，目前可識別員工引入工作環境的約六十種代理類型，涵蓋 Claude Code、Codex 等主流工具。

在權限管理層面，新機制採取動態調整策略：代理的資料存取權限，將依照當前具體任務即時縮放，而非給予固定的廣泛授權。當代理看似即將執行高風險決策時，系統將觸發人工審核流程，要求人類明確批准後方可繼續。這一設計的邏輯，是把「監督責任」留在企業一側，而非轉嫁給模型供應商。

在更宏觀的戰略層面，微軟執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）在其部落格中明確提出：企業必須將「智能的供給」與「行動的授權」分開處理。他強調，即便模型供應商提供了安全保證，企業對自身部署的代理行為依然負有完整的問責義務。微軟亦已成為 NVIDIA 開放代理安全平台的創始成員，加入由逾百家科技企業組成的聯盟；該平台可在硬體層面隔離代理、監控行為，並在必要時執行強制停機。

對於正在為企業客戶引入 AI 代理方案的行銷代理商而言，這一系列動態傳遞出明確的行業訊號：安全治理架構，已從可選附加項升格為提案的必備章節。採購方將愈來愈傾向於要求供應商在方案中說明代理的權限範圍、高風險行為的審核機制，以及監控工具的獨立性。代理商若能提前在提案中納入這類框架性論述，不僅可降低客戶的顧慮，亦有助於在競爭中建立差異化的專業形象。
items.detail_en:
Microsoft's security business chief Hayete Gallot stated plainly that frontier AI models "cannot be trusted" regardless of which vendor supplies them. Her reasoning: these models are trained to complete tasks, not to observe organizational norms or exercise institutional judgment. The implication is a reframing of AI agent risk — away from external attack vectors and toward internal governance. Enterprises must treat their own deployed AI agents with the same scrutiny they apply to insider threats.

In response to this challenge, Microsoft has formally launched Guardian Agents as an extension of Project Perception, which debuted in June 2026. The original framework established three agent classes — red team (simulating attackers), blue team (detecting vulnerabilities), and green team (handling remediation). Guardian Agents expands that monitoring mandate inward, covering all AI agents an enterprise has deployed. Concurrently, Microsoft Defender has added an agent detection capability that can identify approximately 60 types of agents employees introduce into the workplace, including prominent tools such as Claude Code and Codex.

On the permissions side, the new system takes a dynamic approach: an agent's data and system access is scoped in real time to the specific task at hand rather than granted as a broad standing authorization. When an agent appears to be heading toward a high-risk decision, a human approval checkpoint is triggered before execution can continue. The underlying design principle is that accountability stays with the enterprise — it cannot be delegated to a model provider.

At the strategic level, CEO Satya Nadella articulated the governing principle in a post on his personal blog: enterprises must separate the "supply of intelligence" from the "authority over it." He argued that a model provider's assurances do not relieve an organization of responsibility for what its agents do. Microsoft has also joined Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform as a founding member, alongside more than 100 technology companies; the platform can isolate agents in secure hardware environments, monitor behavior continuously, and execute a kill switch when necessary.

For marketing agencies building AI agent solutions for enterprise clients, this series of announcements carries a clear commercial signal: security governance is no longer an optional addendum — it is an expected section of any serious proposal. Procurement teams will increasingly demand that vendors articulate the scope of agent permissions, the mechanism for reviewing high-risk actions, and the independence of monitoring tools from the agent supply chain. Agencies that proactively embed this governance framing into their proposals will reduce client concern and distinguish themselves on professional credibility.

items.title: 維多利亞的秘密時裝秀從廣播奇觀轉型為粉絲共創運動
items.title_en: Victoria's Secret Show Pivots from Broadcast Spectacle to Fan-Led Community Movement
items.summary: 維多利亞的秘密 10 月 18 日時裝秀改為 YouTube 及社媒串流，新增全國天使選拔劇集、票務抽籤及首個 TikTok 後台直播，標誌從廣播模式轉向互動社群體驗的策略轉型。
items.summary_en: Victoria's Secret's October 18 show streamed on YouTube and social channels, adding a nationwide talent search series, fan ticket drops, and the brand's first TikTok Live post-show — pivoting from broadcast spectacle to participatory community experience.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 品牌標誌性活動從廣播轉向社群互動模式，可作代理商重新設計客戶大型品牌活動策略的參考範本。
items.why_en: A landmark brand event pivot from broadcast to participatory social — directly applicable for redesigning flagship event communication strategies.
highlights: 維多利亞的秘密以 YouTube 串流取代傳統電視轉播，配合全國天使選拔劇集，將一次性直播轉化為持續性社群內容。
首次設立 TikTok 後台直播，邀請粉絲即時參與幕後，標誌品牌形象重塑延伸至受眾互動架構的重新設計。
票務抽籤機制令觀眾不再只是打開畫面收看，而是要親自報名搶票，是大型品牌活動社群化的具體執行範本。
highlights_en: Victoria's Secret replaced traditional TV broadcast with YouTube streaming and an ongoing talent search series, transforming a one-time event into sustained social content.
The first-ever TikTok Live backstage stream invited fans into real-time behind-the-scenes access, extending brand redesign to audience engagement architecture.
The ticket lottery mechanism transforms audience from passive consumers to active participants — a concrete execution template for socializing large brand events.
items.detail:
維多利亞的秘密（Victoria's Secret）時裝秀於2026年10月18日在洛杉磯舉行，標誌著這一標誌性活動完成了一次深刻的策略轉型。今年的秀不再依賴傳統電視廣播，而是選擇在YouTube及品牌旗下各大社交媒體頻道進行全球直播。這一決定打破了過往時裝秀作為封閉式廣播奇觀的形態，將觀眾從被動的螢幕前觀看者，重新定位為可以即時留言互動、彼此交流的一群人。

為了將這場活動真正轉化為一場粉絲運動，品牌推出了多項前所未有的參與機制。其一是粉絲票務抽籤制度——有意現場觀賞的支持者須透過抽籤方式爭取入場資格，製造稀缺感的同時亦激發了廣泛的社群討論。其二是名為《Angels Among Us》的系列紀錄片，記錄品牌在全美各地搜尋新一代天使模特兒的歷程，以連載形式將時裝秀的敘事週期從單一夜晚延伸至數週，令品牌內容具備持續的消費動力。

在數位端點的創新上，品牌於秀後首次開啟TikTok Live後台直播，讓觀眾得以進入後台現場，親歷平時隱藏於鏡頭後的準備與氛圍。這一舉措精準切入TikTok用戶對原真性（authenticity）內容的需求，並在秀的正式結束後繼續製造話題熱度，有效延長整場活動的傳播生命週期。首席行銷及客戶官 Elizabeth Preis 將今年的目標定調為「一個充滿樂趣與友誼的夜晚」，清晰呈現了品牌從視覺奢華轉向情感聯結的核心意圖。

這場轉型對奢侈品與時尚行業的活動策略具有顯著的參考價值。長期以來，高端品牌的大型活動傾向於以製造視覺震撼為優先，受邀嘉賓與媒體才是真正的目標受眾，普通消費者僅能從媒體報導中獲得間接接觸。然而，維多利亞的秘密今次的實踐表明，借助社群媒體串流、互動票務機制及內容系列化等工具，品牌完全可以在維持活動高度的同時，將受眾圈層向外大幅擴展。

對於香港及亞洲市場的品牌行銷人員而言，這套模式尤其值得深入研究。在消費者觸媒習慣日益碎片化的當下，以一場直播取代昂貴的電視廣播、以抽籤制度替換傳統貴賓邀請、以TikTok後台直播深化情感連結，所涉及的製作成本與傳播效率之比，遠較傳統廣播模式優勝。更重要的是，每一個參與環節均可產生可量化的數據回饋，為品牌後續的受眾分析與策略迭代提供真實依據。這正是從「廣播奇觀」邁向「參與式品牌社群」的核心轉變，亦是未來大型品牌活動策劃的重要方向。
items.detail_en:
Victoria's Secret held its Fashion Show on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in Los Angeles — and the event marked a decisive strategic transformation for one of fashion's most iconic annual spectacles. Rather than relying on traditional television broadcasting, the brand streamed the show globally via YouTube and its own social media channels. This shift recast the audience from passive television viewers into real-time participants, repositioning the show as a community-driven experience rather than a closed broadcast event.

To deepen fan participation, the brand introduced several new engagement mechanics. A ticket lottery system replaced conventional VIP-only access, creating deliberate scarcity while generating widespread social conversation around entry. Alongside this, the brand launched Angels Among Us, an episodic documentary series chronicling a nationwide talent search for the next Victoria's Secret Angel. By serializing the search process over multiple weeks, the brand extended the show's narrative arc well beyond a single evening, giving audiences a sustained reason to stay engaged with the IP long before the runway lights came on.

On the digital side, the brand executed its first-ever TikTok Live post-show backstage session, granting viewers real-time access to behind-the-scenes moments immediately after the main event concluded. The activation spoke directly to TikTok's audience appetite for authentic, unfiltered content, and kept conversation and engagement elevated in the hours following the show — effectively doubling the event's media lifecycle. Chief Marketing and Customer Officer Elizabeth Preis framed the ambition clearly: the goal was for the evening to feel like 'a night of fun and friendship,' signaling a conscious pivot from visual spectacle toward emotional community-building.

The strategic implications for luxury and fashion brands are significant. Historically, major brand events in this sector have prioritized visual grandeur for an invited audience of press and VIPs, with mass consumers receiving only mediated, after-the-fact coverage. Victoria's Secret's approach this year demonstrates that social streaming, participatory ticketing, and serialized content can meaningfully extend a brand's event reach without diluting its prestige or production quality.

For brand marketers in Hong Kong and across Asia, the model offers a practical blueprint worth examining closely. As consumer media habits grow increasingly fragmented, replacing expensive broadcast slots with owned-channel streaming, substituting traditional guest lists with lottery access mechanics, and deepening emotional resonance through TikTok Live backstage content all represent a more cost-efficient path to large-scale engagement. Crucially, each participation layer generates quantifiable data feedback, providing brands with genuine audience insight to inform future strategy iterations. This is the essence of the shift from broadcast spectacle to participatory fan community — and it represents one of the most instructive case studies in brand event strategy to emerge this year.

items.title: Tesla 飛行汽車引爆借勢行銷潮，Volvo 反向定位脫穎而出
items.title_en: Tesla Flying Car Triggers Brand Trendjacking Wave — Volvo's Contrarian Response Stands Out
items.summary: Tesla 發布第二代 Roadster 推進器飛行功能後，Axe、Volvo、MINI 等逾十個品牌迅速借勢，Volvo 以「腳踏實地」反向定位脫穎而出，馬來西亞品牌 Watsons 與 Carsome 亦即時參與。
items.summary_en: Tesla's Roadster thruster reveal triggered rapid trendjacking from Axe, Volvo, MINI, Fly Norwegian, and Malaysian brands. Volvo's contrarian 'Down to Earth' response stood out as differentiated cultural positioning.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 反向品牌定位在病毒式文化時刻的有效性，可作代理商制定社媒快速反應策略的具體參考框架。
items.why_en: Contrarian brand positioning during viral cultural moments can outperform generic trendjacking — a useful social media rapid-response framework.
highlights: Volvo 以「腳踏實地」反向定位直接回應 Tesla 的飛行噱頭，以品牌特質差異化而非追隨熱點。
馬來西亞本地品牌 Watsons 與 Carsome 亦參與此次借勢行銷，顯示亞太市場對全球文化時刻的即時反應速度正在提升。
借勢行銷的速度與品牌一致性之間的平衡，是代理商協助客戶制定社媒快速反應策略的核心考量。
highlights_en: Volvo's contrarian 'Down to Earth' positioning responded to Tesla's flying stunt by emphasizing brand character differentiation rather than following the trend.
Malaysian brands Watsons and Carsome also joined the trendjacking wave, showing APAC markets are accelerating real-time responses to global cultural moments.
Balancing speed and brand consistency is the core consideration for agencies developing social media rapid-response playbooks for clients.
items.detail:
特斯拉於近期正式揭露第二代 Roadster 的推進器飛行功能，宣稱車輛能藉由機身搭載的噴射推進器短暫升空，此消息一經發布，迅速引發全球逾十個品牌的即時跟進回應，成為近年品牌即時行銷（Real-time Marketing）中討論度最高的案例之一。

各品牌的反應策略呈現明顯差異。Axe 將自身除臭產品包裝成「為 Tesla 提供推力的秘密武器」，以幽默手法完成品牌連結；Hot Wheels 則以「我們 1968 年就在飛了」的資歷宣示搶佔話語權；MINI 翻出 1959 年的黑白老照片，配文「獨自飛翔多年，終於有人作伴」，靈活運用品牌歷史資產。航空公司 Fly Norwegian 則以「我們早就會飛，而且還有廁所」自嘲反擊，把話題拉回務實的服務優勢。電競品牌 Razer 趁勢發布名為「Project McFly V2」的飛行滑鼠概念，將科技感話題與自家產品生態完美嫁接。馬來西亞市場亦見本土品牌積極參與：Watsons 想像顧客倒掛著車體在空中完成 click-and-collect；二手車平台 Carsome 以「編輯失職」為由自我調侃，坦言旗下目前尚無飛行車可售。

然而在眾多品牌的跟風聲浪中，Volvo 的應對策略卻逆流而行，以一句「Down to Earth. Since 1927」（落地踏實，自 1927 年起）宣示自己不跟隨特斯拉升空。這句話的力量在於它並非單純拒絕，而是把品牌一貫強調的安全性、可靠性與務實價值，凝練成一個反向敘事。與其他品牌急於搭上話題列車，Volvo 選擇以品牌立場的一致性換取更深層的記憶烙印。行業分析普遍認為，Volvo 此舉是本次事件中品牌辨識度最高、傳播效益最佳的回應。

此案例為代理商與品牌主提供了一個值得深思的框架：話題跟進（Trendjacking）並非「有參與就有收益」的零成本操作。評估是否跟進時，需先考量三個維度——品牌關聯性（該話題與品牌核心主張的距離）、執行差異化（同類競品是否已飽和佔位）、以及逆向定位的可能性（若反其道而行反而能強化品牌個性）。對於定位清晰、個性鮮明的品牌而言，選擇不跟進、甚至以反向立場表態，往往比千篇一律的跟風貼文更能累積品牌資產。

總結而言，特斯拉飛行車話題所揭示的核心洞察在於：病毒式文化時刻（Viral Cultural Moment）是品牌個性的壓力測試，而非免費流量的提款機。能在同類回應中脫穎而出的，從來不是反應最快的品牌，而是最清楚自己「站在哪裡」的品牌。對行銷代理商而言，協助客戶辨別「何時跟進、何時反向表態」，正是創意策略專業價值的所在。
items.detail_en:
Tesla recently unveiled the thruster-powered flight capability of its second-generation Roadster, claiming the vehicle can briefly become airborne via onboard propulsion. The announcement immediately triggered real-time marketing responses from more than ten brands worldwide, making it one of the most discussed trendjacking cases in recent memory.

Brand responses varied considerably in approach. Axe framed its deodorant as the secret fuel powering Tesla's thrust, landing a playful product connection. Hot Wheels asserted heritage with "We've been doing this since 1968." MINI unearthed a black-and-white archive photo with the line "Flying solo since 1959. Nice to have company," deftly leveraging its brand history. Fly Norwegian deflected with self-deprecating airline humor: "Ours already flies — and it has toilets." Razer seized the moment to tease a flying gaming mouse concept dubbed "Project McFly V2." Malaysian brands also joined: Watsons imagined an upside-down aerial drive-through for click-and-collect, while used-car platform Carsome blamed an absent editor and candidly admitted it had no flying cars on its lot.

Amid the wave of brands rushing to align with Tesla's moment, Volvo took the contrarian route with a single line: "Down to Earth. Since 1927." The power of this response lay not in refusal for its own sake, but in distilling Volvo's longstanding brand values — safety, reliability, and pragmatism — into a counter-narrative. Rather than chasing the viral moment, Volvo used it to reinforce brand consistency, and industry observers widely credited it as the most distinctive and effective response of the entire episode.

The case offers practitioners a practical framework for evaluating trendjacking decisions. Three dimensions deserve consideration: brand relevance (how close is the moment to the brand's core proposition?), execution differentiation (has the space already been saturated by competitors?), and the contrarian opportunity (would going against the grain actually reinforce brand character?). For brands with strong, clearly defined positioning, opting out — or even staking out an opposing stance — can generate more lasting brand equity than a generic "me too" post ever could.

The broader lesson from the Tesla flying-car moment is that viral cultural events function as stress tests of brand identity, not free traffic dispensers. The brands that cut through are rarely the fastest to respond; they are the ones most certain of where they stand. For marketing agencies, helping clients distinguish between when to trendjack and when to take a contrarian position is precisely where strategic creative value lies.

items.title: LinkedIn 推出可掃描數位名片，支援存入數位錢包
items.title_en: LinkedIn Launches Scannable Digital Business Cards with Digital Wallet Integration
items.summary: LinkedIn 推出個人化數位名片，包含頭像、職銜與 QR Code，可存入數位錢包，支援外觀客製化，未來數月陸續向全球用戶開放。
items.summary_en: LinkedIn is rolling out personalized scannable digital business cards with headshot, job title, and QR code, storable in digital wallets with customizable designs, launching globally over the coming months.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: B2B 客戶可用數位名片取代實體卡，是代理商為金融及專業服務客戶更新 LinkedIn 品牌形象的好切入點。
items.why_en: B2B clients can replace physical cards — a practical hook for agencies advising finance or professional services clients on LinkedIn strategy.
highlights: LinkedIn 數位名片支援存入 Apple Wallet 及 Google Wallet，掃描後可直接查看個人 LinkedIn 個人檔案。
外觀設計可客製化，支援加入公司識別色彩與標誌，適合代理商向 B2B 品牌客戶推薦作為名片的數位升級方案。
功能目前開始向部分用戶推出，並將在未來數月內向全球完整開放。
highlights_en: LinkedIn digital business cards can be saved to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, allowing recipients to scan and immediately view the LinkedIn profile.
Customizable designs support brand colors and logos — a practical upgrade that agencies can recommend to B2B brand clients replacing traditional business cards.
The feature is beginning to roll out to select users and will be fully available globally over the coming months.
items.detail:
LinkedIn 於 2026 年 10 月宣布推出可掃描的數位名片功能，並在「Connection by Design」發布活動中正式亮相。這項功能允許用戶在平台內設計一張專屬名片，卡面自動整合個人頭像、職銜描述及 QR Code，掃描後可即時跳轉至對方的 LinkedIn 個人主頁。用戶完成設計後，可將名片存入 Apple Wallet 或 Google Wallet，在線下場合直接以手機展示或讓對方掃碼，毋須再依賴實體紙卡。LinkedIn 表示，功能目前正向部分用戶優先開放，並將於未來數月內逐步向全球所有帳戶推送。

LinkedIn 並非首次嘗試二維碼名片——早在 2018 年，平台便曾推出個人 QR Code 功能，然而當時缺乏設計自訂選項與數位錢包整合，最終未能形成廣泛使用習慣。此番全新數位名片的核心升級，正是在設計靈活度與生態整合兩個維度同步突破：用戶可套用品牌主色調與企業標誌，令卡面視覺符合公司識別規範；另一方面，存入錢包的機制使名片獨立於 LinkedIn 應用程式之外，即便對方沒有安裝 LinkedIn，也能透過 QR Code 完成連結，大幅降低了資訊交換的門檻。

對 B2B 業務而言，這一功能的實用價值主要體現在線下交流場景：行業展會、客戶拜訪、高階主管峰會等場合，名片交換仍是建立初步信任的慣例動作。LinkedIn 數位名片令整個流程轉移至個人的職業身份平台，同時保留了紙卡的即時性與直觀感。值得注意的是，由於名片資訊直接連結至持續更新的 LinkedIn 個人檔案，收件方日後所見的職銜、公司及聯絡方式，始終與最新狀態保持同步，徹底消除了實體名片資訊過時的痛點。

對於金融服務、專業顧問及高管層級的客戶而言，LinkedIn 數位名片提供了一個低摩擦的品牌觸點升級機會。企業可以要求員工統一套用品牌色與標誌，使每一次名片交換都成為一致的品牌接觸，這對合規管理嚴謹、對外形象高度一致化的金融機構尤具吸引力。與此同時，行銷團隊亦可將數位名片納入執行活化計劃，為參加行業會議的高管或業務代表預先設計標準化卡面範本，確保品牌呈現不因個人設定差異而失序。

整體而言，LinkedIn 數位名片並非顛覆性的技術創新，而是一次切中實際需求的功能整合。它解決的是一個長期存在卻被低估的場景缺口：職業社群平台與線下人際連結之間的斷層。功能全面普及後，B2B 從業者在人脈建立上將擁有一個更具說服力的數位入口，而能夠率先將品牌設計系統延伸至這一觸點的企業，將在第一印象層面佔據明顯優勢。
items.detail_en:
LinkedIn announced the launch of scannable digital business cards in October 2026, unveiling the feature at its 'Connection by Design' event. The cards automatically incorporate the user's profile headshot, job title, and a QR code that links directly to their LinkedIn profile. Once designed, the card can be saved to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, allowing users to share their professional details in person simply by displaying their phone — no paper card required. LinkedIn confirmed the feature is currently rolling out to select users, with a full global release expected over the coming months.

This is not LinkedIn's first attempt at QR-based networking. The platform introduced profile QR codes back in 2018, yet the feature failed to gain meaningful traction, largely because it offered no design customization and no integration with digital wallet systems. The new digital business card addresses both of those gaps simultaneously. Users can apply brand colors and company logos to align the card visually with corporate identity standards. Meanwhile, wallet integration means the card functions independently of the LinkedIn app itself — recipients can scan the QR code without having LinkedIn installed, significantly reducing friction in the information-exchange moment.

For B2B professionals, the practical value is clearest in high-stakes offline settings: industry conferences, client visits, and executive summits where business card exchange remains a baseline trust ritual. LinkedIn's digital card moves that ritual onto a verified professional identity platform while preserving the immediacy of a physical card. A particularly meaningful advantage is that the card links to a live LinkedIn profile, meaning the job title, company affiliation, and contact details visible to a recipient stay current as the holder's career evolves — eliminating the perpetual problem of outdated printed cards.

For clients in financial services, professional advisory, and executive roles, the digital business card represents a low-friction opportunity to strengthen brand consistency at the point of first contact. Organizations can require employees to apply unified brand colors and logos, turning every card exchange into a controlled brand impression — an especially compelling proposition for regulated industries where external presentation must meet strict compliance standards. Marketing teams can also incorporate digital card templates into executive activation programs, pre-designing standardized card layouts for representatives attending industry events to ensure visual consistency regardless of individual setup choices.

Overall, LinkedIn's digital business card is less a technological breakthrough than a well-timed integration that closes a long-overlooked gap between professional social platforms and in-person networking. Once the feature reaches full global availability, B2B practitioners will have a more credible and seamless digital entry point for relationship building. Organizations that extend their design systems to this new touchpoint early will hold a visible edge at the moment that arguably matters most — the first impression.

items.title: Goodway Group：以「刻意自動化」框架，將策略時間佔比從 10% 翻至 90%
items.title_en: Goodway Group Flips Strategy-to-Execution Ratio to 90/10 with 'Intentional Automation' Framework
items.summary: Goodway Group 採用「刻意自動化」框架與 Fluency 合作，將 AI 代理應用於媒體執行，令策略時間佔比從 10% 提升至 90%，簡報至上線週期縮短至 1.5 週。
items.summary_en: Goodway Group partnered with Fluency to flip its strategy-to-execution ratio from 10/90 to 90/10 using agentic AI. Brief-to-live time dropped to 1.5 weeks. Core principle: rules-based execution with LLMs only for exceptions.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 代理商 AI 轉型的具體執行路徑，分拆例行決策與例外處理的框架可直接套用於媒體執行工作流重組。
items.why_en: A concrete agentic AI playbook for agencies — the rules-vs-exceptions framework is directly applicable to restructuring media ops workflows.
highlights: Goodway 的核心原則是以業務規則自動處理例行決策，AI 大型語言模型只應對無法用規則解決的例外情況。
導入「刻意自動化」框架後，從接到簡報到廣告上線的週期從數週縮短至 1.5 週。
此框架直接適用於代理商媒體運營的轉型規劃，可作為向管理層說明 AI 代理導入路線圖的具體案例。
highlights_en: Goodway's core principle: encode repeatable decisions as business rules and use LLMs only for exceptions that fall outside those rules.
After adopting the 'intentional automation' framework, brief-to-live time dropped from multiple weeks to just 1.5 weeks.
This framework is directly applicable to agency media operations transformation planning and serves as a concrete case for management-level AI agent adoption roadmaps.
items.detail:
Goodway Group 與程序化廣告執行平台 Fluency 的合作，為業界提供了一個最具可操作性的代理式 AI 落地範例。這家美國中型代理商在評估逾 70 家 AI 優先合作夥伴後，以「持有更少、編排更多」作為核心策略方向，將跨平台的渠道運營知識嵌入 Fluency，由後者承接高重複性的執行工作。其核心認知是：代理商的競爭力在於策略洞察，而非程序性的廣告排期與素材配置。

Goodway 將此方法論命名為「有意識的自動化」（intentional automation），最顯眼的成果是將策略與執行的時間比例從 10:90 完全翻轉為 90:10。一支四人跨職能小組將從簡報到活動上線的周期壓縮至 1.5 週以內，比原先需要人手加班方可完成的同等工作快了約五成。值得注意的是，這一速度提升並非以犧牲品質換取，而是藉由消除流程冗餘環節實現——人工審核不僅保留，更成為架構的核心組成。

框架的治理原則採取「規則優先、例外才用大型語言模型」的設計：對可重複的決策環節以確定性業務規則處理；只有規則無法覆蓋的邊緣情況，才引入 LLM 判斷，並設有觸發人工介入的機制。這反映出對規模化成本的務實考量——LLM 的 token 成本在大規模部署中會成為真實財務壓力，找到傳統軟件邏輯與 LLM 的平衡點是可持續運營的前提。

Goodway 的案例之所以可被直接複製，在於其框架提供清晰的實施指引：先審計現有流程再疊加自動化；組建橫跨媒體、數據與管理層的跨職能小組；在擴大自動化範圍前先以人工驗證規則邏輯；並明確劃定「選擇不做的事」——Wolk 的原則是「你選擇不做的事，與你決定做的事同樣重要」。對於正在評估 AI 轉型路徑的香港中型代理商而言，這套由實戰數據支撐的框架，遠比概念層面的 AI 論述更具即時參考價值。
items.detail_en:
Goodway Group's partnership with programmatic execution platform Fluency stands out as one of the most practically replicable agentic AI case studies available to mid-size agencies. After evaluating more than 70 AI-first vendors, the US-based agency adopted a strategic posture of 'own less, orchestrate more' — embedding its cross-channel expertise into Fluency's infrastructure to handle repetitive execution at scale. The core recognition was that an agency's competitive advantage lies in strategic insight, not in procedural campaign setup and asset trafficking.

Goodway describes the methodology as an 'intentional automation' framework, with its headline result being a complete inversion of the strategy-to-execution time ratio: from 10/90 to 90/10. A four-person cross-functional team compressed the brief-to-live timeline to under 1.5 weeks — roughly 50% faster than equivalent work that would previously have required additional staff working nights and weekends. Critically, this speed gain was achieved not by cutting quality checkpoints but by eliminating redundant steps; human review remains embedded throughout the architecture.

The governance principle underpinning the framework is a rules-first, LLMs-for-exceptions model: deterministic business rules govern all repeatable decisions, while large language models are reserved only for undefined edge cases, with a mandatory escalation path that flags a human to intervene. This reflects a practical concern about cost at scale — token costs become a real financial variable in large deployments, making a calibrated balance between LLM reliance and traditional software logic a prerequisite for sustainable operations.

What makes the Goodway model directly replicable is its staged implementation guidance. Agencies should audit processes before automating, assemble cross-functional teams spanning media, data, and leadership, validate rules with human review before expanding scope, and deliberately define what not to build — as Wolk's principle holds: 'just as important as what you do is what you choose not to do.' For Hong Kong mid-size agencies assessing their own AI transformation roadmap, this evidence-backed operational framework offers far more immediate reference value than AI discourse at the conceptual level.
